description: Experimentation configuration: control vs variant, success metric, duration.
An account-based engagement campaign spanning channels and target accounts.
Per-worker per-leave-type running balance: accrued, taken, scheduled, available. Calculated against time_off_policies and reset per accrual cycle.

Worker-initiated request for time away: PTO, sick, parental, bereavement, jury duty, FMLA. Carries policy, eligibility check, approval chain, and accrual deduction. Called Leave Request (UK), Vacation Request (US), PTO Request.

WCAG violation detected by automated scanning (color contrast, alt text, heading hierarchy, interactive-element labels): severity, guideline reference, affected element selector, remediation steps, pages affected.

Retail/commercial customer request to open a deposit or payment account: account type (checking, savings, money market, business), initial funding, linked services (card, online banking, mobile), identity-verification flag. Distinct from ATS recruiting applications.

An account- or contact-level marketing engagement / in-market propensity score derived from intent and activity. Distinct from REV-INTEL sales-activity engagement scores and from GTM-PLAN planning-grade account scores.
A resolution of anonymous web/signal traffic to a known account or contact.
An account's progression through orchestration stages from awareness to opportunity.

Completion record for a new deposit/payment account: institution, account number, IBAN/routing, account type, customer, funding method, activation date, initial balance. Derived from account_applications; drives downstream provisioning.
A planning-grade fit/priority score per account, derived from the ICP and segment model.
Time bucket within a fiscal year: status (open / soft_close / closed / locked), period dates, calendar/fiscal alignment. Drives period-end close orchestration.
Team or manager action commitment in response to engagement_drivers result. Tracked to closure; recurring failure to act is itself an engagement signal.
Configurable rules that decide which captured activities count toward which opportunity or account for engagement and attribution reporting.
Raw operational metric feeding emissions calc: kWh, fuel liters, waste tonnage, commute miles. Mapped to emission_factor → emissions_record. Broader than REAL-EST `utility_meter_readings`.
A targetable audience definition: custom (uploaded or pixel-built), lookalike / similar, saved interest-and-demographic, or suppression list, synced to one or more ad platforms.
A budget assignment and pacing record for a campaign or ad set, including caps, the reallocation decisions made by the optimization loop, and the resulting spend split over time.
An account or audience targeted by an account-based ad campaign, with channel and tier.
A conversion or signal event sent server-side to an ad platform (Meta Conversions API, TikTok Events API) and matched back to paid social delivery for optimization and attribution.
A reusable creative building block (image, video, headline, body copy, logo, CTA) stored for assembly into creatives and variants.
A product catalog feed used to drive dynamic product ads and feed-based creative, mapping catalog fields to creative templates per platform.

FCRA-mandated notice issued when a background_check result is used to decline a candidate. Two-step process: pre-adverse notice + waiting period + post-adverse final notice. Carries notice type, sent timestamp, copy_of_report enclosure, dispute window expiry.
A record linking advocacy-share-driven traffic to a lead, opportunity, or pipeline value for social-selling attribution and program ROI.
A time-boxed push that groups advocacy content around a launch, event, or theme and sets participation targets for advocates over a defined period.
A curated, approved content item (article, post, image, video, or link) made available to advocates to reshare, with suggested share copy and a sharing window.
A topic channel or feed that groups advocacy content by theme so advocates can follow and filter the subjects relevant to them.
An automated, personalized digest of shareable content sent to advocates to prompt participation, generated per advocate from their opted-in topics.
A ranking board of advocates by points, shares, reach, or earned media value over a period, used to recognize and motivate participation.
An append-only ledger entry recording points awarded to or redeemed by an advocate for a specific action (share, content creation, challenge completion).
A configured employee advocacy program: its enrolled audience, content topics, sharing rules, branding, and goals. The container an organization runs advocacy within.
A reward in the advocacy catalog that advocates can redeem with earned points (gift cards, swag, recognition), including its cost and redemption lifecycle.
Per-share engagement measurements: clicks, impressions, reactions, comments, reach, and earned media value attributed to an employee share.
A single act of an employee resharing an advocacy content item to one of their linked personal social accounts, including the channel, timestamp, and any personalized copy.
A personal social network account (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram) an advocate has connected and authorized for one-click resharing.
An employee enrolled as an advocate: their participation status, opted-in topics, gamification standing, and the personal social accounts they have linked for sharing.
A computed influence score for an advocate derived from network size, engagement rate, reach, and share performance over a window.
Seed / fertilizer / chemical / fuel stock across farm bins and sheds; reconciled against applications and purchases.
Pre-engagement client estimate priced from rate cards, expected effort, and media/production cost lines with markup. Approval converts the estimate into an agency_job with locked billing terms.

Central engagement record for an agency client, the unit of billable work. Carries client, brief, deliverables, traffic state, retainer link (if any), assigned team, and rolled-up financials. Distinct from PSA `projects` by retainer linkage, creative-brief origination, and media-plan attachment.

Recurring fee agreement with a client: monthly amount, included scope (hours or deliverables), period, and live burn-down against logged time + costs. Surfaces over-burn alerts, replenishment triggers, and period roll-forward.

Record of a staffing or search agency submitting a candidate against a requisition. Carries the submission date, the ownership and dedup window that determines which agency owns a placement when more than one submits the same person, and the fee terms that apply if the submission converts to a hire.

Time logged against an agency_job + task + deliverable by an employee or freelancer, with client-rate-card application, billable/non-billable/agency-overhead coding, and discipline tagging (strategy, design, account, production). Follows the `msp_time_entries` precedent for vertical-specific time data.
Contact-center agent presence + availability + pause-code state transitions (ACD foundation).
A deliverable unit of work below an epic, sized to be completed within a program increment by one or more teams on a release train.
A long-lived team-of-teams structure that plans and delivers a continuous flow of value on a common cadence.
A time-phased view of planned epics and features across upcoming program increments, used for release planning and stakeholder communication.

Registered LLM agent or generative-AI workflow: prompt templates, tool bindings, retrieval indexes (RAG), evaluation harness, deployed endpoints, audit log, and cost/safety policy. Lives in the platform's AI tier.
AIOps noise-reduction rule — patterns to filter / suppress (known-noise signatures, maintenance exclusions).
Per-product-line allergen map, changeover validation procedure, labeling controls, supplier-attestation references.

Veterinary patient (companion animal, livestock, equine): species, breed, sex, date of birth, weight, microchip, color, identifying marks, ownership history. Distinct from human-patient records (no PHI scope).
A sale or purchase transaction for animals or mobs, with counterparty, head count, weights, price, and destination. The commercial close-out of an animal's on-farm lifecycle.
A vaccination, treatment, or medicine administration for an animal or mob, with product, batch number, dose, date, and the withholding period that gates sale and slaughter eligibility.
A weigh observation for an animal or mob session, with weight, date, and source (manual or scale-head capture). The series drives average-daily-gain and growth-curve computation.
Detected deviation from learned normal behavior: KPI excursion outside seasonality bands, novel error pattern, traffic shape change. Feeds correlation and predictive_signals.
Runtime registration of an API consumer: API key provisioning, scopes assigned, quota allocation, on/off toggle. SUB-MGMT co-master decision for `api_subscriptions` (business slice) deferred.
Runtime instance: which API version runs where (prod, staging, regional). Tracks rollout, canary, regional distribution.
Gateway infrastructure: deployment targets, throughput config.
Rules governing access, transformation, rate limits, authentication.
OpenAPI / AsyncAPI / GraphQL schema defining the interface contract. APIM publishes; APM `application_interfaces` reference via FK.
Aggregate call counts, latency percentiles, error rates per version/consumer. APIM observability layer.
Versioning lineage (v1.0, v2.0, sunset dates); each version has distinct policies, deployments, audience.

OFCCP-mandated log of every Internet Applicant against a requisition, capturing demographic data, expressed interest, basic qualifications, and disposition. Federal contractors must retain for OFCCP audit; the record is independent of EEO voluntary self-id.
Aggregated cost per enterprise application: license fees, infrastructure, support, personnel, cloud usage. Refresh monthly/quarterly; feeds FINOPS.

Typed reason-for-non-selection on a job application. Drives OFCCP applicant-flow reporting and internal hiring analytics; distinct from `application_stage_transitions` which logs the stage change but not the categorized business reason.
Named integration point between two applications (API, ETL, message queue, file-drop, manual); carries payload type, data owner, frequency, SLA.
Candidate-supplied answer to an application_screening_question on a specific job_application. Drives auto-disqualify on knockout rules.
Custom screening question attached to a job_posting or template (knockout questions, qualifying questions). Carries question text, type (boolean/single-select/free-text), required, knockout rule.
Audit-trail record of an application moving between stages. Carries from_stage, to_stage, actor, timestamp, reason. Source of cycle-time, time-in-stage, and conversion-rate analytics.
Configured stage in the recruiting pipeline (sourced, applied, screened, phone_screen, onsite, offer, hired). Per-requisition or per-template ordered list; defines the lifecycle of a job_application.
Multi-dimensional time-series score per application: criticality, revenue attribution, adoption, strategic alignment, technical health. Quarterly refresh.
User satisfaction signals: rating, helpful/not-helpful votes, comments.
Audit trail of article edits: prior_version_id, author, timestamp, change_summary, revert capability.
Stock-based compensation expense recognition per period per cohort of grants. Uses Black-Scholes or lattice models with forfeiture / modification accounting.

The lease-accounting journal entries generated for posting to the general ledger under ASC 842 or IFRS 16: initial recognition, periodic amortization and interest, modification, and termination entries, with preparer and approver controls.
Per-learner per-attempt audit row: start time, score, pass/fail, time-on-task. FINRA / Part 11 evidence substrate.
Item-bank entry: question stem, choices, scoring, and metadata for randomization.

Lease, maintenance, support, or warranty contract governing an asset or pool of assets. Distinct from contract templates / signature artifacts (CLM-mastered): this is the ITAM-side index of contracts attached to physical or software assets. ITAM contributes the asset-pool linkage; CLM masters the contract document itself.
Per-fixed_asset per-book depreciation calculation timeline: period-by-period depreciation expense and accumulated depreciation. Drives the monthly depreciation journal_entries.

Cross-cutting lifecycle audit log applicable to hardware, software, and SaaS assets: procurement, deployment, transfer, retirement, disposal. ITSM (incident-driven failure events), HCM (employee termination → recall), and Onboarding (provisioning) all contribute events.
GP carry / management-fee schedule / performance-fee waterfall — required for true LP-return calculation.

Forecast of voluntary and involuntary attrition over a planning horizon, typically broken down by org unit × tenure × performance band × geography. Derived from historical patterns and predictive models; consumed by SWP to update plan assumptions (the canonical attrition.forecast_updated handoff).

Defined segments / cohorts (high-value-active, 90-day-churn-risk, holiday-shoppers, post-purchase-anchor). Computed from events + attributes; activated outbound to MA for campaign targeting, to B2C-COMM for personalized storefront, to SALES-ENG for outreach prioritization.
Dynamic learner segment defined by attributes (department, location, role) and used by auto-enrollment and notification rules.
Scoped fieldwork initiative; scope statement, budget, team, timeline, procedures. Lifecycle: planned → in_progress → draft_report → completed.
Observed control deviation, process gap, or non-compliance discovered during fieldwork; condition, criteria, cause, impact, remediation owner, target date. Triggers GRC issues via handoff.
Identified gap, risk exposure, or non-conformance from assessment, audit, or policy exception. Carries priority, due date, owner, status.
Multi-year audit strategy and annual planning calendar defining audit-universe coverage, risk-based scoping, and timing.
Forward-looking corrective-action proposal from fieldwork; risk rating, proposed owner, target date, expected cost/benefit.
Formal deliverable: executive summary, scope, findings + recommendations ranked by severity, management response, sign-off.
Rule engine entry that auto-enrolls learners into courses or paths based on audience membership and lifecycle events.

A reusable script (PowerShell, Bash, batch, Python) in the RMM tool's script library for remote execution against managed endpoints, with version history, parameter schema, scheduled runs, and per-target execution outcome.
Human review decision on a completed background_check (Clear / Engaged / Decisional / Declined). Carries adjudicator, decision rationale, individualized assessment notes per EEOC guidance.
Individual sub-check result inside a background_checks order (e.g. county_criminal, ssn_trace, employment_verification, drug_screen). Each component has its own status, result, and provider source.
Candidate-initiated dispute of a background_check component result under FCRA rights. Carries disputed component, candidate statement, provider re-investigation result, resolution.

Configured bundle of check types (county criminal + national + MVR + drug screen + employment verification + education verification) that can be ordered as one unit. Catalog-shaped: defines what a 'standard package' looks like for a role tier.
External verification result for a candidate (criminal, employment history, education, credit, identity). Status and findings typically returned by an external screening provider.
Owned cash or operating account at a bank: institution, account number, IBAN/routing, currency, intended use (operating, payroll, AP, trust). Drives cash management and payment runs.

Customer-banking issue / dispute / escalation: dispute type (unauthorized transaction, fraud claim, account error, complaint, regulatory concern), account involved, opened date, assigned agent, SLA, resolution status, root cause. Distinct from CSM customer_cases and ITSM incidents.

Know-Your-Customer / Anti-Money-Laundering assessment: customer risk classification, beneficial-ownership confirmation, source-of-funds verification, PEP screening, sanctions-list match, watchlist refresh cadence, reviewer sign-off, refresh-due date. Required for origination and annual recertification.

Posted transaction on a bank account: posting date, type (debit / credit / transfer / fee / interest), amount, currency, counterparty, reference, reconciliation status vs bank statement. Distinct from ERP-FIN journal_entries (the accounting side).
A seller-facing competitive card: how we win against a named competitor, with objections and counters.
Insurance provider, 401(k) recordkeeper, or COBRA administrator that fulfills a benefit_plan. Drives the carrier_feeds integration.
Person covered under an employee's benefit plan (spouse, domestic partner, child, disabled adult). Carries relationship, DOB, SSN, dependent-eligibility documents.
Per-employee per-plan elected coverage record with effective dates, covered dependents, contribution amounts, and beneficiary designations. The source of truth for deduction calculation in payroll.

Annual employer-defined window during which employees may elect or change benefit_plans for the next plan year. Drives mass campaign communications, decision-support tooling, and a synchronous load on the carrier_feeds layer at close.

Configurable employer-sponsored benefit offering: medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401(k), HSA/FSA, voluntary. Carries eligibility rules, contribution structure, plan year, carrier and coverage tiers.
Post-initiative metric capture: realized ROI, strategic-goal achievement, scope-vs-plan variance. Closes the loop from business_value_assessments.
Controlled release cohort (customers, features, date range) for validation before GA.
Interactive multi-visualization dashboard bound to semantic models in the BI tool.
Saved exploration or prepared query authored in the BI tool.
Published BI report authored and served by a BI tool (workbook, dashboard-bound report, or saved look).
Scheduled delivery configuration (email report, chat alert, webhook push) for a BI report or dashboard.

Medium-neutral catalog description of an intellectual work or expression, encoded in MARC21 or BIBFRAME. Covers books, ebooks, periodicals, serials, audio recordings, video, maps, manuscripts, datasets, and any other library material regardless of format.
A running on-account balance for a boater that fuel, store, and service charges post to and that is settled periodically.
A marina customer: contact details, communication preferences, account balance, and the vessels and contracts they hold.
A boatyard service job on a vessel: repairs, winterization, detailing, or commissioning, with labor, parts, and status.
Static conversational-AI bot configuration: persona, instructions, system prompt, disambiguation rules.
Style/tone deviation from brand guidelines detected by AI/pattern-matching (unauthorized terminology, off-brand phrasing, regulatory language drift): violation type, recommended fix, detected date.
Reproductive event: natural service / AI / embryo transfer with sire, technician, date; preg-check result downstream.
A breeding-cycle event: joining, pregnancy test, calving or lambing, with sire, dam, offspring, and birth weight. Tracks reproductive performance across the season.
HTTP 404 / timeout / redirect-chain detected by link audit: source URL, target URL, status code, first-detected date, affected content count. High-friction signal across multi-vendor properties.

Pairing of a new hire with an existing employee for the onboarding period — buddy, mentor, peer-coach, or sponsor depending on the program. Carries scope (peer / cross-functional), start and end dates, and meeting cadence.

Binary, container image, package, or other output produced by a ci_pipeline_run: type (docker_image / npm_package / jar / binary / archive), version, registry URL, SBOM reference, signed flag. Promotion source for deployments.
Property certification record (LEED, BREEAM, WiredScore, seismic, accessibility) supporting underwriting + tenant appeal.
Outbound milk-tank shipment to processor / co-op: pickup time, volume, milk-quality grade, hauler.
Hierarchical map of an organization's business capabilities (typically L1/L2/L3), with maturity/investment/strategic-fit heatmaps and linkage to applications, processes, value streams, and owners.

A modeled artifact representing a business process (BPMN 2.0, EPC, or proprietary diagram), with version graph, lifecycle state, and metadata (owner, scope, framework lineage). Distinct from a process instance (runtime execution); this is the design-time definition.
Declarative rule inferred from event-log patterns: conditional activity orderings, forbidden sequences, timing constraints, resource allocations, decision thresholds. Captures hidden control logic.

The container for a single corporate journey: the purpose, dates, traveler, and the set of booked segments that make it up. The unit that is approved, tracked, reconciled, and handed to expense and spend.
Scoring model for prioritizing portfolio items: NPV, strategic alignment, risk, dependencies, resource constraints. Ranked backlog.
Whole / half / quarter-animal pre-order: deposit status, customer cut-sheet preferences, processor coordination, pickup date.
A Change Advisory Board meeting record: agenda, attendees, the changes reviewed, decisions, and minutes. The first-class artifact of the CAB review step in change management.

2D drawing records derived from CAD models, with their own revision, approval, and title-block metadata. Drawings often have a release cycle distinct from the 3D model they reference, especially in regulated industries where the drawing IS the controlled artifact.

CAD file metadata records (parts and assemblies). The vault stores the source CAD file (mechanical part and assembly files, electronic schematic and PCB files); this is the database record that tracks owner, check-in/out state, revision, viewable, and which engineering_revision it backs.

Recorded sales call: audio/video, transcript, participants, talk-track / topic / sentiment metadata. Conversation-intelligence tooling attaches this to deals and feeds conversation_intelligence_records downstream.
Timestamped annotations left on a recorded call during review, tied to the moment in the conversation they refer to.
Common-area-maintenance expense pool tracked annually, allocated to tenants based on pro-rata share with gross-up to occupancy, audit caps, and exclusion of capital items.
Library item for assessments (coding challenge, work sample, take-home, skills test). Carries title, vendor, time limit, scoring rubric. Materializes into candidate_assessments when assigned.
Skills, cognitive, technical, or personality test result attached to an application. Often sourced from an external assessment provider and referenced here.
Per-candidate opt-in record for GDPR / CCPA / data retention. Carries consent type, jurisdiction, granted timestamp, withdrawal timestamp, retention window.

File artifact attached to a candidate (resume, cover letter, portfolio, work sample, signed disclosure, reference letter, right-to-work proof). Carries document type, MIME type, storage URI, uploaded-by actor, uploaded-at timestamp, and visibility scope.

Persisted email correspondence with a candidate as a first-class threaded record, distinct from free-text application notes and engagement summaries. Captures sent and received messages, the template used, and delivery status across the candidate relationship.
Single recruiter-to-candidate touchpoint (email, InMail, call, SMS, event invite). Carries channel, direction, timestamp, status, and content reference.

Free-form recruiter or hiring-team note on a candidate, internal-only, never sent to the candidate. Carries author, body, visibility scope (private to author, team, or hiring panel), timestamp, and optional at-mentions to other team members.
Multi-touch automated outreach sequence targeting talent-pool segments. Carries cadence, step templates, audience filter, and lifecycle state.
Employee-submitted candidate suggestion linked to a requisition. Tracks the referring employee, candidate, status, and any payable bonus.
Many-to-many junction between candidates and candidate_tags. Carries assigned_by, assigned_at, and optional context.
Free-form label applied to a candidate to support segmentation, search, and pool inclusion rules. Distinct from talent pools (curated membership lists). Carries name, optional category, and color.
Person known to the recruiting org, with or without an active application. Carries contact details, resume, tags, GDPR consent, and source. Distinct from Employee until hired.
Authoritative shareholder ledger for an issuing company: securities, classes, holders, transaction history.
A sales-capacity model: coverage, ramp, and productivity assumptions sized against the revenue target.

Resource utilization snapshots (CPU, memory, disk, throughput, IOPS) at fixed intervals for capacity planning, trend analysis, and FinOps cost allocation. The infra-side counterpart to OBS metric_series.
LP-facing notice document for a capital call, in standard reporting format, with publication timestamps; stored separately from the capital-call record.
Per-LP line item against a capital call: allocated amount, due date, funded amount, funded date.
Notice issued by GP to LPs requesting funding per commitment percentages; carries call amount, allocation, due date, funding receipt tracking.
Building improvement, renovation, or expansion; budget, timeline, completion status.

Collection of physical or digital documents submitted together for IDP processing. Carries batch_id, source_system, capture_date, document_count, status (received / in_progress / completed / failed), and audit metadata.
An automatically captured email, meeting, or call attributed to an opportunity and account, removing the manual logging burden and keeping the activity record complete.
Real-time pre-authorization event from card network with policy decision — distinct from EXPENSE settled card_transactions.
Authorization / settlement record from a corporate_card feed: merchant, MCC, amount, FX, posting date. Matched to expense_lines for full audit trail.

Coordinated care document for a patient condition: goals, interventions, target dates, responsible providers, monitoring frequency, escalation triggers. Used in chronic-disease management, transitions of care, and oncology pathways. Patient-centric (distinct from project plans, treatment protocols).
Worker-declared career interest: target roles, mobility preferences (geographic, functional), aspired timeline. Drives internal-mobility matching.
AI-projected route from a current role toward an aspiration, with required skills (distinct from employee-authored career_aspirations).

Outbound integration to a benefit_carrier (EDI 834 enrollment, 820 remittance, custom API, file_drop). Mostly weekly batch; failures cause coverage discrepancies between HR system of record and carrier of record.
Session-scoped cart holding products before checkout; item quantities, pricing, promotions. Abandoned carts feed MA nurture.
Taxonomy of HR ask types (Pay, Benefits, Leave, Policy, Time, Compensation, Performance, Employee Relations, Compliance). Drives routing, SLA, knowledge-article lookup, and trend analytics.

A case file for flexible, non-sequential knowledge work: a container of ad-hoc and planned activities, milestones, and stage gates where the path is decided by workers at runtime rather than fixed in a process model.
Posting to a bank_account: incoming receipt, outgoing payment, transfer, fee. Drives reconciliation against journal_entries and bank statements.
Call and screen recording from a contact-center session. Distinct from SALES-ENG call_recordings.
Real-time or shift-frequency CCP monitoring reading; deviation triggers corrective-action workflow.
PDF / image template used to issue a certificate to a learner; carries layout and dynamic fields.
Catalog of certification types: name, issuing authority, validity period, recertification policy, prerequisite courses.
Renewal cycle of an existing certification, distinct from initial issuance.
Earned-credit ledger row per learner; CEU evidence for state-CE, NASBA, and similar professional licensure reporting.

A detected conflict between overlapping changes or a change scheduled inside a blackout window. Records the colliding changes, the window in question, and the resolution. Surfaces scheduling conflicts before they reach implementation.
Change-data-capture log metadata: source database table, captured columns, capture mode (row-level / query-level), watermark positions.
File pinned or shared at channel level (not per-message): file_id, channel_id, shared_by_user, shared_at, expiry_policy, access_permissions. Distinct from KMS authored knowledge.
Membership relationship linking a user/external guest to a channel: join_date, role (owner / moderator / member), notification settings, access_level.
The strategic channel-mix master: which routes (direct, partner, digital, PLG) carry which segments. Spend-execution allocation lives downstream in Marketing Automation and the ABM platform.
Persistent conversation space: private, public, or DM. Carries name, topic, member list, retention policy, external guest federation. The foundational WSC organizing unit.
Synchronous audio/video meeting spawned from a channel or DM: huddle_type (voice / video), participants, start/end, duration, recording_reference, transcription_reference.
File or link embedded in a message: attachment_type (file / link / image / video / integration_card), file_id/url, file_size, upload_timestamp, virus_scan_status.
Single message posted to a channel or thread: author, timestamp, content (text, emoji, markdown, rich-text preview), attachments, edit history, reactions. Distinct from email messages or SMS.
Nested conversation branch within a channel message: parent_message_id, replies, thread participants, read state. Enables focused sub-conversations.
Transactional checkout session capturing customer identity, payment method, shipping address, and final order conversion.
A hazardous substance in the chemical inventory, with quantity, location, and links to its safety data sheet and exposure limits.
Captured configuration state at a point in time, used for drift detection, approved-state validation, and audit evidence. Triggers an unauthorized-change incident when current state diverges.

The CI type hierarchy (Computer → Linux Server → Web Server, Application → Microservice → REST API) defining schema, inherited attributes, and class-level monitoring/discovery policies. The schema-of-schemas for the CMDB.

Single execution of a ci_pipeline: triggering commit, start/end timestamps, duration, overall status (success / failed / canceled), per-stage results, runner. The unit for DORA deploy-frequency and change-fail-rate metrics.

Pipeline definition (build / test / scan / deploy): source_repository reference, trigger conditions (push / PR / scheduled / manual), stage configuration, secrets binding. Scope-qualified vs DI data-pipelines.
Edges in the CI graph: depends-on, runs-on, contains, member-of, hosted-by, communicates-with. The topology that makes service mapping, impact analysis, and event correlation possible.
Allocation of claims to adjusters: adjuster, assigned_date, claim_count, caseload_status, assignment_reason (intake / escalation / specialty / reassignment). Drives adjuster workload analytics.
Disbursement to claimant, provider, or vendor: amount, payment date, check/EFT reference, reserve basis, line-item allocation to coverages. Distinct from generic payments (rent, AR, supplier).

Settlement agreement specifying approved amount, conditions, releases, and closure terms for a resolved claim: settlement_date, payee, breakdown by coverage, structured-settlement schedule, release language.
A versioned, governed collection of approved contract clauses, often organized by jurisdiction or contract type, that authors draw from.

Professional-services engagement record (used by ACCT primarily but generic across professional services): client, service line, scope, fee model, period, status. Distinct from `engagement_letters` (the contract artifact).
Matter-scoped invoice generated from time entries + disbursements + retainer drawdowns.

Documented patient-provider clinical contact: encounter date, type (office visit / telehealth / inpatient / ED), chief complaint, vitals, ICD diagnosis codes, CPT procedure codes, provider, attending. The atomic billable clinical event; precedes patient_charts and clinical_notes.

Request from clinical staff for device repair, configuration, training, or incident investigation; routed via clinical-engineering team. Links to device_maintenance_logs and device_incident_reports for closed-loop traceability.

Provider documentation of patient encounter: SOAP-style (subjective/objective/assessment/plan), nurse notes, progress notes, discharge summaries. Patient-chart artifact; supports billing, continuity, legal record. Distinct from ECM documents (filing-cabinet view) — clinical_notes are structured clinical artifacts.

Provider order for diagnostic test, medication, therapy, or procedure: order type (lab / imaging / prescription / referral / DME), order date, ordering provider, target facility/department, priority, result attachment. CPOE-compliant; distinct from S2P purchase orders.
Managed cloud database, warehouse schema, dataset, workspace, or cluster. Structured-data container at security-posture lens.
Cloud object-storage bucket or container holding unstructured data. Lens distinct from CMDB configuration_items (security-posture vs IT-ops topology).
Worker-node grouping: instance type/size, scaling config, taints/tolerations, labels, zone distribution.
cmi5 (ADL) assignable unit launched against an LRS; modern course-package standard supplanting SCORM.
A manager evaluation of a call or rep against a talk-track rubric, scoring adherence to the playbook on defined criteria.
A one-on-one coaching review, usually anchored to a recorded call, scheduled and then completed with notes and follow-up actions for the rep.

Git commit on a source_repository: SHA, author, timestamp, message, parent SHA(s), diff summary, signed-off-by. The atomic unit for value-stream analytics (lead-time computation, change-volume tracking).

Cited non-compliance with permit conditions, building code, business regulation, or other government code: subject (property / business / individual), violation code, citation date, issuing inspector, severity, fines assessed, remediation status.
Customer purchase order created at checkout, tracked through fulfillment and completion. B2C seller-side; distinct from S2P `purchase_orders` (supplier-issued buyer-side).
Sellable product: name, description, SKU, pricing, inventory references. B2C-COMM-mastered v1; future PIM domain will co-master when loaded.
Physical or digital shipment associated with a fulfillment; carrier, tracking, delivery status. Includes RMA returns.
B2C brand / channel storefront (web store, mobile app, marketplace listing) with catalog mapping. One seller may have N storefronts.

Commercial real-estate lease (office/retail/industrial) carrying base rent, CAM, escalations, percentage rent, tenant improvements, free-rent abatement, and renewal options. Operationally distinct from residential leases and from tenant-of-corporate-office accounting-only leases.
Per-transaction commission distribution across listing-side and buyer-side brokerages, then internal agent splits per franchise rules; referenced by accounting and 1099 processes.
Imported market salary data for a job-level-geography combination, sourced from an external compensation-survey provider. Drives salary_bands maintenance.

Total-rewards package definition per role, level, location: base structure, bonus target, equity guideline, allowances. Distinct from sales-incentive plans (those live in Sales Performance Management).
Personalized total-rewards letter delivered to a worker showing the value of base, bonus, equity, benefits, and perks. Generated on hire, merit cycle close, and annually.
Role-anchored bundle of required skills plus target proficiency levels, used for gap analysis and internal matching.
A tracked piece of competitor or market intelligence with source, relevance, and disposition.
A profile of a tracked competitor: positioning, pricing, strengths, and weaknesses.
Mandatory training assignment tied to a regulation, role, location, or hire-event (anti-harassment, AML, GDPR, OSHA, HIPAA). Carries due date, escalation policy, audit log.
Regulator-facing audit trail row capturing who did what training when, with version and evidence reference. Distinct from learning_records: audit-purpose subset, retention-locked.
Mitigating action or safeguard designed to reduce risk; control type (preventive / detective / corrective), design scope, owner, test frequency.
Artifact proving fulfillment of an obligation: audit report, assessment result, signed attestation, log export. Carries obligation_id, type, retention.
Requirement imposed by a regulation or internal policy that must be fulfilled; distinct from contract_obligations (commercial) and controls (mechanisms).
Formal governance directive (acceptable-use, data-protection, whistleblower, anti-corruption); version, effective date, scope, owner, approval chain.

Tenant-scoped reference table of statutes a tenant is subject to (jurisdiction, citation, retention period). Each tenant activates only its applicable subset; the regulation field on training_evidence_records is an FK into this table, and the active rows gate which compliance evidence applies.
Identified threat to organizational objectives; likelihood, impact, inherent / residual severity, owner. Links to controls and risk factors.
Campaign container that bundles assignments by audience and due-date: annual code-of-conduct cycle, harassment refresh, security awareness wave.

Canonical record of an IT thing under management: server, container, application, business service, network device, database, cloud resource. The flagship CMDB entity, referenced by changes, incidents, problems, and topology. Multi-feed: DISCOVERY auto-populates, HAM provides the physical-asset overlay for hardware CIs, SAM/SMP overlay for software/SaaS CIs.

Conflict-of-interest checking record: search inputs (proposed new client, parties), matches across existing matters/clients/adversaries, resolution (cleared, waived, declined), ethics-wall configuration.
A source intranet platform under governance (the connector target): platform type, base URL, auth, crawl schedule, and status.
Lawful-basis and opt-in/opt-out state governing whether a contact's signals may be processed and activated (GDPR Art. 6/7, CCPA/CPRA).

A normalized contact-center customer-identity record reconciling phone numbers, email addresses, and known customer_ids across channels. Helps the agent see context regardless of which channel the customer used.
Image repositories scoped to the cluster: registry policies, pull secrets, image scanning.
Pod / Deployment / StatefulSet / Job / DaemonSet primitives: replica counts, restart policy, QoS class, affinity rules.
A per-worker record that a mandatory broadcast or piece of content was read and acknowledged, used as read-receipt proof under union and policy content rules.

Inventory + quality assessment of web content: page count, health score (WCAG accessibility, SEO health, broken links, brand-voice compliance), staleness, orphaned pages. Scheduled or on-demand scan against a website corpus.
A curated grouping of enablement content by stage, persona, or play.
Reusable composable block (hero, CTA, text, image, form). Many components per page.
Binary file + metadata container; the ECM flagship entity. Distinct from DCG `data_assets` (metadata catalog) and DAM `digital_assets` (creative/brand).
An append-only event capturing when content is opened, shared, or tied to a deal; carries buyer contact identity.

Individual structured content record conforming to a content_type, served via the CMS delivery API to any channel. The thing a headless CMS exists to manage. Industry synonyms include Entries, Documents, and Stories depending on the headless CMS in use.
Isolated working copy of a CMS's content: dev, staging, or production environment; dataset, branch, or space. Used to test content-type changes and content migrations safely before promoting.

Editorial calendar + governance rule set for content retirement/refresh: content reference, review-due date, owner, refresh frequency, sunset date, successor content. Ties to editorial workflows and triggers remediation tasks when content misses deadlines.
Configured locale available within a CMS account or environment, including fallback chain, default locale flag, and translation status conventions. Drives field-level localization on content entries.

A scheduled batch of content changes published together, used to coordinate go-lives across many entries (campaign launch, product update). Industry synonyms include Releases, Launch, and Scheduled Releases depending on the headless CMS in use.
A multichannel content-syndication program delivering gated content to target accounts.

Schema definition for a class of content entries: fields, references, validation, and locale settings. CMS-specific configuration; renames or removals couple tightly to downstream frontend code. Industry synonyms include Models, Schemas, and Content Types depending on the headless CMS in use.
Supplier-issued invoice for contingent labor, computed from contingent_timesheets × rate_cards. Routed through AP-AUTO for three-way match and payment.
Hours-worked timesheet from a contingent_worker against a work_order: approved hours, expenses, project codes. Feeds contingent_invoices for supplier billing.

Non-employee resource: 1099 contractor, agency staff, statement-of-work consultant, intern. Carries supplier, role, rate, end date, classification basis. Distinct from employees by lifecycle, payment path, and benefits eligibility.
CEU credit-value master: credit hours, accrediting body, eligible courses.
A formal change to the terms of an executed contract, tracked as its own record with an approval and signature trail.

Reusable clause library: preferred and fallback language for indemnification, IP, termination, SLA, payment terms, data-protection, AI-use, audit rights. Drives consistency in authoring and accelerates negotiation.
The external party to a contract, held as its own record because a counterparty is not always a CRM account or supplier and may sign many contracts.
Approved-quote handoff artifact; precursor to CLM `contracts`. CPQ owns the draft; CLM owns the signed contract + amendments.
A date-driven checkpoint in a contract (for example a delivery date or review date), distinct from a deliverable obligation.
A structured thread of negotiation rounds and counterparty exchanges on a contract, separate from the clauses and the contract itself.

Specific performance, payment, delivery, reporting, or compliance commitment extracted from a contract — each with its own owner, due date, and status. Post-signature obligation tracking is where contracts deliver (or fail to deliver) value.
A record of a single renewal of an existing contract, capturing the renewed term, pricing, and outcome distinct from the original agreement.
A structured assessment of the legal or commercial risk in a contract or clause, produced during review and dispositioned by a reviewer.
Pre-approved drafts (NDA, MSA, DPA, SOW, order form) assembled from the clause library, used to author new contracts. Carries versioning, approval state, and risk-tier classification.
A contractor or third-party safety prequalification and qualification record, with safety criteria, status, and ties to site access and permit-to-work.
Test result verifying a control's operating effectiveness; tester, scope, result, evidence reference, remediation status.
Audit's execution view of a control: what was tested, how, sample size, exceptions found, evidence file references. Distinct from GRC control_assessments (continuous).
DEA-required controlled-substance receipt, dispensation, and disposal record: drug, schedule, quantity, dispenser, recipient (patient), reconciliation evidence.
Commitments and follow-ups extracted from a conversation, tracked from open to done so reps and managers can confirm post-call execution.
Dialog state machine / branching graph that orchestrates a conversational journey.

AI-extracted insights from calls, emails, and meetings: competitor mentions, pricing discussions, sentiment shifts, commitments made, action items, risk signals. Feeds opportunity stage signals back to CRM and deal-coaching recommendations to managers.
Topic mentions extracted from a recorded conversation: competitor references, pricing discussion, objections, and next-step commitments, each tagged with the transcript span it was found in.

A turn-by-turn record of a bot or AI-assistant conversation: utterances, intents identified, confidence scores, slot fillings, escalation events. Source-of-truth for AI training, audit, and root-cause analysis.
SPEND-MGMT-side card-issuance and control record. Distinct from EXPENSE corporate_cards (reconciliation).
Issued corporate card record: issuer, last four, cardholder, account, status, controls (per-transaction limits, MCC blocks). Feeds the card_transactions stream.
A corrective or preventive action arising from an incident, inspection, audit, or finding, with an owner, due date, and verification of effectiveness.
Organizational unit for cost allocation: name, code, manager, hierarchy, currency. Drives variance reporting and project / departmental P&L. A near-universal foreign key in finance and payroll.
Promotion code or campaign offer (discount, BOGO, free-shipping) applicable to cart/order. Storefront-scoped or global.
Quiz or exam definition associated with a course or lesson; carries passing score and attempt policy.
Scoped catalog view: subset of courses surfaced to a specific audience, branch, or domain.
Hierarchical taxonomy for catalog browsing and reporting.
Terminal completion record per learner per course version. Distinct from learning_records (event log).
Forum-style discussion thread attached to a course or lesson; collaborative-learning surface.
Per-learner per-course state record: assigned date, due date, attempts, status (not_started, in_progress, completed, expired), score. The operational unit of learning tracking.
Intra-course composition unit grouping related lessons; supports completion tracking at sub-course granularity.
Scheduled instance of a course: date range, location, capacity, language, delivery mode.
Numeric rating (typically 1-5) per learner per course; aggregate analytics surface.
Handout, supplementary material, or pre-read attached to an offering or session.
Learner-authored qualitative review of a course post-completion.
Individual session within a multi-day offering; carries per-session attendance and instructor assignment.
Free-form taxonomy alongside categories; supports faceted search.
Versioned snapshot of a course's content lineage. Required for compliance retention: regulators ask which version of training each learner completed.
Atomic learning unit: e-learning module, video, live session, blended program, external content. Carries content reference, duration, format, language, prerequisites, certification award.
Health incident: mastitis, lameness, metabolic disorder; treatment, withdrawal period, recovery status.

Initiating document for a creative job: client objective, audience, key message, mandatories, deliverable list, deadlines, and budget. Authored by account/strategy, approved by client, drives creative-team scoping.
Asset under production within an agency_job: an image, video, layout, copy doc, or campaign element with version history and proofing/approval state. Final approved versions register in DAM.
A named variation of a creative produced for testing or dynamic creative optimization, combining specific asset choices (headline, body, image, CTA) with its own performance trail.
Open Badges / micro-credential definition: criteria, image, issuer, expiration policy. Distinct from visitor_badges (physical access).
Third-party verification handshake for an issued badge or credential (Open Badges 3.0).
CCP definition with hazard, critical limit, monitoring frequency, responsible party; child of a HACCP plan.
FSMA-204-defined CTE: growing / receiving / transformation / creation / shipping event with KDE references.

Person at a customer account (B2B) or contact-level record (B2C-relevant). Carries title, email, decision-maker flag, preferred channel, opt-in state. MA contributes engagement data; SALES-ENG contributes cadence touchpoints.

Pre-qualification prospect record — source, score, status (new/working/qualified/disqualified/converted), assigned rep, conversion target (which contact + account it would become). MQL handoff from MA lands here.
Active sales deal — stage, amount, close date, probability, products/SKUs, competitor, decision criteria. Drives CPQ quote generation and closed-won triggers downstream subscription activation.
Per-field seasonal planting plan (crop, variety, target yield, application schedule); includes multi-year rotation history.
A dependency between work owned by different teams or trains that must be coordinated and resolved to keep the program increment on track.
Per-member per-season subscription: share type, customization preferences, payment plan, pickup location.
Per-week packed share for a specific member: contents, swaps applied, packing-list reference, delivery / pickup status.

Customer satisfaction, NPS, or CES survey response tied to a case, interaction, or relationship-level survey. Drives retention scoring and feeds churn-risk signals back to SUB-MGMT and account-health into CRM.
Grouped paths and courses targeting a role, function, or compliance scope. Used by Workday and Cornerstone as the primary noun for role-based learning.

Derived / calculated attributes attached to the resolved profile: LTV, RFM score, propensity-to-buy, churn-likelihood, preferred-channel, lifecycle stage. The materialized scoring layer of the unified profile; downstream segments and personalization rules read from here.

Customer-facing support ticket — the flagship CSM entity. Distinct from ITSM `incidents` (internal IT) and `service_requests` (catalog-driven internal requests). Carries severity, channel, queue, SLA clock, customer + contact references, CSAT linkage. SUB-MGMT-driven dunning failures and CSM-detected churn risk both surface as cases.

What support a customer can use — service tier (Silver/Gold/Platinum), monthly support hours, supported channels (email/chat/phone), named contacts, included services, SLA response targets. Activated from the SUB-MGMT subscription.activated handoff.

Unified event stream — every customer interaction across web, mobile, email, in-product, sales-engagement, support. The firehose CDP is built around: typically millions of events per day per active customer base. Multi-feed from MA (campaign events), B2C-COMM (storefront), CRM (sales activities), CSM (support interactions), product instrumentation. The customer-side counterpart to ITOM's `events`.
Qualitative or quantitative feedback from customers on product experience, gaps, or opportunities.
Single resolved customer identity across all source systems (CRM/CSM/SUB-MGMT/CDP), resolved via match/merge/survivorship rules. Distinct from operational `customers`.
Seller-issued invoice — line items, tax, payment terms, due date, status (draft/sent/paid/overdue/written-off). **AR side**; distinct from S2P `invoices` (AP-side, supplier-issued).

Observed multi-channel journey progression — the inbound view of how a customer moved through touchpoints over time. Distinct from MA `nurture_journeys` (orchestrated outbound sequences): customer_journeys are descriptive (what happened), nurture_journeys are prescriptive (what we'll do).

Physical service location belonging to a customer. One customer can have many sites (commercial chains, multi-property landlords, residential customers with multiple properties). Distinct from CRM accounts (the commercial relationship) and from internal locations (the service organization's own facilities).

Customer's recurring revenue contract — plan, term, MRR/ARR, billing cadence, seat count, lifecycle (trial / active / paused / canceled / churned). **Seller-side view**; distinct from `saas_subscriptions` (SMP, buyer-side view of what we consume from vendors).

Canonical record of a customer — account (B2B) or end-customer (B2C). Carries identity, segmentation, lifecycle stage, account hierarchy, and pointers to opportunities, cases, subscriptions, and unified profile. The flagship customer-facing entity and the catalog's most multi-mastered row: CRM masters the sales view, CSM the service view, SUB-MGMT the financial view, CDP the unified resolved profile. The structural twin of `employees` on the customer side.
Individual cow record: ear tag, breed, birth date, sire / dam, parity, current lactation status, location pen.
Video-telematics incident record: AI-detected event (collision, near-miss, distracted driving), video clip(s), driver, vehicle, timestamp, severity. Feeds insurance claims and safety coaching.

Governance rule controlling who can access a data_asset: audience, permission level, conditions, approval chain, audit trail. Distinct from infrastructure-level IAM policies (DSPM `iam_access_policies`).
Cataloged data-bearing entity (table, dataset, API, database, file) with metadata, owner, storage location, format, record count, source system reference. DCG's flagship.
Attestation that a data_asset meets quality / compliance thresholds for production use; certifier, date, valid-until, conditions. Distinct from DQ rule pass/fail.
Sensitivity tag applied to data_assets (PII, PCI, PHI, Sensitive, Confidential, Internal). DCG masters the taxonomy; DSPM/DLP apply at rest and at egress respectively.
GDPR Article 17 right-to-erasure request: scope, anonymisation policy, regulator deadline, fulfillment status.
Logical subject-area / domain grouping (Customer, Order, Inventory) organizing multiple data_assets with ownership and documentation.
Raw event of sensitive data being moved/accessed outside authorized boundaries; precursor to dlp_incident (filter: did policy trigger?).
Flow edge from source data_asset to target data_asset with column-level mapping, transformation logic, frequency, SLA. Represents ETL/dbt graphs.

Pipeline definition and its run history: ELT/ETL jobs, streaming pipelines, dbt-style transformation models, and managed ingestion connectors. Includes scheduling, dependency graph, lineage edges to source and target tables, and run-level observability (status, duration, rows processed).

Published, governed data product with an explicit contract: schema, SLA, owner, access policy, intended consumers, quality expectations, and versioning. Backed by one or more lakehouse_tables, pipeline outputs, or semantic_metrics. The unit of data exchange between producer teams and consumer teams under a data-mesh / governed-marketplace model.
A data processing addendum attached to a contract that governs how personal data is handled, with its own approval and renewal cycle.
Per-asset risk score combining sensitivity + access breadth + exposure vector; prioritizes DSPM remediation queue.
Assignment of a steward (user) to a data_asset or glossary_term; responsibility type (owner / contributor / reviewer), escalation chain. Used by both DCG and MDM steward workflows.

GDPR Articles 15-22 (and analogous CPRA/PIPEDA) request from a candidate exercising access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, or objection rights against personal data the ATS holds. Tracks request type, intake channel, due date, fulfillment, and verification.
Aggregated consumption signal per data_asset: accessing_team, query_count, last_access, bytes scanned. Drives popularity and stale-asset detection.
Cloud analytics-specialized database or cluster with a distinct access model from transactional DBs.
Enclosed or open cabinet within a rack: front/rear layout, power distribution, cable management, access control, temperature sensor zones. Holds servers, network gear, UPS, patch panels.
Physical cable plant: from-port → to-port, cable length, type (fiber / copper / power), installation date, test state, failure history. Distinct from dc_port_connections (logical endpoints).
Forward-looking projection of power, cooling, space, bandwidth capacity per site/zone/period: utilization forecast, headroom, planned augmentations. Drives growth planning and colo negotiations.

Request to install, decommission, or relocate equipment in the data center (a move, add, or change). Carries the requested action, target rack or cabinet, scheduling, and approval before the physical work is executed and the asset register is updated. Scope-qualified to the physical floor so it does not collide with ITSM change_requests.
CRAC, CRAH, or in-row cooler: capacity (kW), zone served, inlet/outlet temperature setpoint, current power draw, refrigerant state. Required for thermal capacity assessment.
Real-time/historical temperature, humidity, airflow, pressure from cabinet/aisle/zone sensors. Time-series telemetry for hot-spot detection.

Network or power port on a device (server NIC, switch port, PDU outlet): interface name, speed/type (10GbE / 40GbE / RJ45 / IEC309), neighbor endpoint, vlan/circuit assignment, usage status. Topology for network and power connectivity.
Electrical circuit from site feed to PDU outlet: capacity (amps/watts), utility meter reference, voltage, phase assignment, breaker state, redundancy config.
Rack or cabinet PDU: input phases, output outlets/breakers, per-phase/outlet metering, managed (SNMP) vs manual, firmware version. Critical for capacity planning and load balancing.
Physical rack frame: height in RUs, location (room/row/aisle), power budget, cooling zone, asset tag. Parent = data center site. Holds cabinets and equipment.
UPS or rotary power pool unit: input/output capacity, battery health, last test date, load level, bypass state. Site or zone-level unit.
A dynamic creative optimization rule set governing how variants are generated from assets and feeds and how delivery is weighted toward performers.
Per-opportunity machine-derived risk grade with the feature contributions that drove it, recomputed as new activity, conversation, and CRM signals arrive.
Named risk patterns raised against an opportunity, such as no identified decision-maker, no scheduled next step, or single-threaded engagement, tracked from raised to cleared.

A recorded runtime evaluation of a decision table against a set of inputs: the matched rules, the resulting outputs, and the invoking process instance. The audit trail of every decision the engine made.
A versioned Decision Model and Notation decision table: input and output clauses, rules, and a hit policy, authored once and invoked by running processes to evaluate business rules at runtime.

Configurable definition of a deduction (pre-tax 401k, post-tax Roth, medical premium, HSA, garnishment, union dues) with priority, ceiling, and GL mapping. Drives net-pay arithmetic and benefits-payroll integration.
A detected constraint or slow stage in a value stream surfaced from measured flow, prioritized for remediation.
Optimized multi-stop DTC delivery route per delivery day: vehicle, driver, stops, time windows.
A modeled end-to-end path that delivery work flows through across the toolchain, from idea to production, used as the unit of flow measurement.
Business case submission for new initiative or feature: requester, justification, estimated cost, timeline, approval workflow.
Sequencing and blocking relationships between initiatives and roadmap items; critical path, lag time, external dependencies.
Self-service workplace hoteling: employee reservation of available desk, date/time, work mode. Core to flexible/hybrid workplace policies.
Which mobile_app_packages are pushed to which enrolled_devices: assignment status (pending / installed / failed), install timestamp, removal flag.
Accuracy verification for clinical equipment (scales, infusion pumps, diagnostic devices). Frequency mandated by FDA/accreditation; tracks calibration date, technician, tolerance acceptance.
Baseline policy defining required device state: OS version floor, encryption enforcement, app blocklist, jailbreak/root detection, password policy. Evaluated per enrolled_device per scan.
Periodic scan result per enrolled_device: policies evaluated, pass/fail per policy, non-compliant findings, available remediation actions, scan timestamp.
Device settings template: WiFi credentials, VPN config, certificate pinning, security baselines, disk encryption enforcement, OS hardening. Version-controlled, assigned to device cohorts.
Outcome log for each policy/profile/app deployment: trigger (compliance-push / scheduled / manual), timestamp, success flag, error_code, device state delta.
FDA MDR-style adverse-event report (patient injury, near-miss, unexpected behavior): root cause (user error vs device defect); links to device_recalls when patterns emerge.
Preventive and corrective maintenance records per medical_device: PM schedule completion, technician notes, parts replaced. Regulatory audit trail for clinical compliance.
FDA/regulatory recall notices and clinical-facility response: recall scope, risk level (Class I/II/III), affected serial numbers, remediation, patient-safety impact assessment, regulatory reporting.

Image, video, audio, document, or design file with metadata, rights, taxonomy, and delivery URLs. The DAM master; HCMSs contribute content-bound assets uploaded inline to entries and consume DAM-hosted assets by URL reference. PIM and B2C-COMM also reference product imagery via DAM.
Named digital experience / journey (e.g. 'post-purchase flow', 'lead nurture campaign'). Mapped to segments + A/B variants.

Detected degradation affecting SaaS consumption: slow boot, app crash, unresponsive login, network disconnect, proxy/firewall block, VPN drop, USB mount failure. Source agent telemetry, severity, affected user count, business-app association.

Logical entity/dimension/hierarchy model decoupled from physical tables. Defines conformed dimensions across fact tables, hierarchies, slowly-changing-dimension behavior, and graph-style relationships. The semantic structure metrics resolve against.
State-mandated and brokerage-policy disclosure forms attached to transactions (agency disclosure, property condition, lead paint, HOA documents); required for compliance audit.
Workflow records gating discount authority: approver (manager / finance / sales-ops), accept/reject.

Pre-CMDB candidate emitted by a scan, awaiting normalization and reconciliation into a configuration_item. The buffer between raw scan output and the curated CMDB; some candidates never promote (transient, duplicate, scope-excluded).

Algorithmic output: inferred process model (DFG, BPMN, Petri net) mined from an event log via discovery (Heuristics Miner, Inductive Miner, Fuzzy Miner). Carries fitted parameters, quality metrics (fitness, precision, generalization).
A discovery job execution: scope (subnet, cloud account, k8s cluster, AD forest), credentials used, start/end timestamps, candidates emitted, errors encountered.
Connector / probe / credential definition for a discovery integration: hypervisor, public-cloud account, Kubernetes cluster, directory service, SNMP credential. The configuration that drives scans.

An assignment of a work_order to a specific technician at a specific time. Captures dispatch decisions, route optimization output, dispatcher overrides. Audit trail for what was assigned to whom and why.
Post-call wrap category / business-reason taxonomy for routing logic + analytics.

End-to-end request traces across microservices — parent-child spans, service identification, latency attribution. The fundamental observability artifact for diagnosing latency and dependency issues in service meshes.
LP-facing notice document for a fund distribution, in standard reporting format, with publication timestamps; stored separately from the distribution record.
User or admin-approved exception to a DLP policy; time-limited; tracks requestor, approver, business justification, expiration.
DLP policy violation event from an exfiltration attempt; user, timestamp, classification, destination, action taken, remediation status.
Rule set defining data-protection behavior: conditions (user role, destination, classification, network) and actions (block, quarantine, redact, mask, watermark, alert).
Blocked or flagged artifact (email, file, message) in temporary hold pending admin review or user override request.
Audit trail of user interactions with DLP system: blocks, quarantine reviews, exception requests, policy violations. Supports forensic investigation.
An invoice issued to a boater for dockage, storage, utilities, fuel, or service, with payment status.
Output of document-type classification: classified_document_type (invoice / contract / form / receipt / id / other), classification_confidence, model_version, timestamp.
Metadata classification per ECM taxonomy (DCAT-style, custom records-class). Distinct from DCG `data_classifications` (sensitivity).
Hierarchical containment for documents (folders, libraries, nested collections).
Version history / audit trail per document; tracks publication and revision lineage.
A computed delivery-performance benchmark (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore) for a value stream.
Data-protection-officer training acknowledgment record (GDPR Art. 39).
Canonical quality dimension (completeness, uniqueness, validity, timeliness, consistency, accuracy). DAMA/ISO reference data.
Aggregated quality score per asset/time-slice: weighted roll-up of dimension scores, trend, direction. Consumed by BI dashboards.
Contractual thresholds: max % null, max duplicate rate, max rule-breach count per day, incident response time.
Telemetry-detected risky-event record: harsh braking, hard acceleration, cornering, speeding, fatigue, or distraction. Carries severity, location, video clip reference (when dashcam present).
Aggregated safety + efficiency risk metrics per driver (speeding, harsh braking, idle).

Pre-employment drug test or occupational health screening ordered as a check distinct from the criminal and employment background check. Tracks the order, provider, result, and any adverse-finding review, and handles sensitive medical data subject to ADA and state-law restrictions.
A request to launch a dry-stacked vessel for use and return it to its rack, scheduled against forklift capacity.
A rack position in a dry-stack storage building: bay, level, and maximum vessel length and weight.

Payment failure / retry / collection / past-due-warning records driving the involuntary-churn workflow. Surfaces as customer cases when CSM intervention is required; escalates to write-off if collection fails.

A raised notification that a traveler may be exposed to an emerging risk at their destination, correlating traveler location from active trips against destination risk intelligence, and tracked through acknowledged and resolved states during assistance.

Preventive or corrective maintenance task on an industrial asset: PM cycle, breakdown repair, inspection, calibration. Carries asset reference, trigger source (PM schedule / meter threshold / fault / inspection), task lines (labor + parts + downtime), assigned technician/crew, status lifecycle. Distinct from REAL-EST `facility_work_orders` (building maintenance), FLEET-MAINT `vehicle_work_orders` (fleet), and FSM customer-facing work orders.

Configurable definition of an earning type (regular, overtime, bonus, commission, severance, retro-pay) with tax treatment, GL mapping, accumulator rules, and country localization. Foundation of the payroll calculation engine.
Litigation data request (internal or from external counsel): matter reference, scope (custodians, date range, keywords), requested record types, production timeline, chain-of-custody.

Workflow definition for editorial review and publishing: named states (draft / in_review / approved / published), transitions, and role-based step ownership. Distinct from ECM document workflows (different content shape and lifecycle).

Voluntary self-identification submitted by an applicant for EEO-1 / OFCCP / VEVRAA reporting (gender, race/ethnicity, veteran status, disability). Required compliance artifact for US employers >100 employees; stored separately from candidates record per regulation.
A management-system audit against a standard such as ISO 45001 or ISO 14001, with nonconformities and findings routed into corrective actions.
A safety inspection or observation conducted against a checklist, with findings routed into corrective actions.
An occupational risk assessment such as a job hazard analysis or job safety analysis that scores the likelihood and consequence of identified hazards and assigns controls.
A record of EHS training, competency, or certification completed by a worker, mapped to the roles and regulations that require it.
Electronic Logging Device hours-of-service record per FMCSA Part 395: driving / on-duty / off-duty / sleeper-berth status changes, supporting roadside-inspection mode.
People to contact in an emergency for a worker, with priority ordering and relationship. Holds personal data on third parties beyond the employee.
Lookup mapping activity (natural gas, electricity, freight) to emissions coefficient; sourced from IPCC/EPA/Defra; versioned by effective date.
Physical fact of Scope 1, 2, or 3 GHG emissions from a facility, activity, or supply-chain tier; CO2-equivalents with timestamp and source.

Spouse, children, and other dependents of a worker, held as person-level records on the worker. Benefits administration reads these for eligibility and beneficiary designation; the plan-enrollment record is held separately by benefits.
Per-employee portal account in the equity-administration product. Embedded_masters equity_grants for portal visibility.
Single resolved employee identity across HCM/Payroll/IGA/T&A sources.

Canonical record of a person currently or formerly employed by the organization. Carries identity (legal name, contact, IDs), employment metadata (start date, end date, employment type, country), and pointers to position, job profile, org unit, manager, and life-event history. The most multi-mastered data object in the catalog: HCM masters the core HR slice, Payroll masters the comp/withholding slice, and IGA masters the identity/access slice. Onboarding, PA, and Talent Management consume or contribute.

Contractual terms of employment: contract type (permanent, fixed-term, contractor, intern), start and end dates, governing jurisdiction, working hours, notice period, IP and non-compete clauses, references to the signed document. HCM masters; HRSD contributes when employee-relations cases reference contract terms.

Lifecycle event records for an employee: hire, promotion, transfer, leave start, leave return, comp change, termination. The audit history that drives plan-vs-actual analytics (PA consumer) and downstream system updates. HCM masters; PA derives metrics from the event stream.
A seller training tied to content or a launch: certification, pitch practice, or onboarding module.

ML-derived behavioral deviation on a device: CPU spike during login, memory leak, unexpected network egress, certificate validation failure, impossible-travel pattern. Scored, triaged, feeds InfoSec dashboards.

Quality-of-experience metric for a user/device/SaaS-app triplet: latency, availability %, error rate, device responsiveness (boot time, app launch, login success %). Aggregates synthetic + RUM signals. DEM flagship.
Calculated driver score (e.g. Strategy, Growth, Recognition, Wellbeing, Leadership) at a team/department/segment grain. The action layer of engagement listening.

Formal engagement letter or proposal between professional-services firm and client: scope of work, fee structure, retention period, e-signature evidence, retainer-payment receipt. Used by legal, accounting, and consulting practices.
A computed rollup of activity intensity per account or per contact, summarizing how engaged a buying group is over a period.
Employee engagement, pulse, and sentiment survey responses. Mastered by PA (or by a specialized engagement-platform when used). Drives segment-level engagement scoring and intervention triggers.

Parent-child line items in the engineering BOM. Each row represents one child part under a parent assembly, with quantity, reference designator (for PCB / mechanical), effectivity (from-revision / from-date / from-serial), and find number. ECOs add, remove, or alter these lines.

Engineering Change Order (ECO) master. Captures the proposed change, impact analysis (where-used traversal), CAB approval routing, effective date, and the set of affected parts / BOMs / drawings. Frozen on submission; only the CAB can override after that.

The engineering item master: every distinct part number, assembly, or purchased component the engineering organization recognizes. Anchors revisions, BOMs, CAD files, and the downstream item-master feed to ERP and MES.

System, software, and hardware requirements with parent-child decomposition (system → subsystem → component requirements). Carries verification method (test / inspection / analysis / demonstration), allocated subsystem, and traceability links to test cases (via the existing requirements_to_test_traceability junction).

Revision records on an engineering part (rev A, B, C). Each released revision is a frozen snapshot of the part's attributes, BOM, and CAD references; engineering change orders are the only mechanism that mints a new released revision.

Device under MDM/UEM management: enrollment identity, status (active / suspended / unenrolled), ownership (corp / byod), managed-by-profile reference, last sync timestamp. Distinct from HAM `hardware_assets` (financial lifecycle) and CMDB `configuration_items` (topology).
Zero-touch provisioning credential: token string, QR code, validity window, device-assignment batch, redemption count, expiry. Distributed for device onboarding.

Individual business application in the enterprise portfolio (custom-built, on-prem, SaaS, hybrid) with owner, criticality, lifecycle state, vendor/platform, strategic value. Distinct from ATS `applications` (job-submission). APM's flagship entity.

An e-signature transaction wrapping one or more signature requests against a contract or document. Lifecycle: created → sent → in_progress → completed (or declined / voided / expired). Distinct from CLM's signature_records (the legal-side authoritative record of signed agreements); ESIGN's envelopes capture the e-sign-platform lifecycle while CLM consumes the completed result.
Pathogen-EMP sample: zone (1-4), site, sampling date, lab result; aggregated into trend analytics.
An environmental permit for air, water, or waste, with its conditions, limits, monitoring obligations, and renewal schedule.

Per-asset or per-asset-class preventive-maintenance template: trigger basis (runtime hours / cycle count / calendar time / meter threshold), task list, frequency, due-date generation rules. Drives EAM `eam_work_orders`. Distinct from FLEET-MAINT `preventive_maintenance_schedules` (vehicle-specific: mileage / engine hours / DTC).

RSU, option, or PSU award tied to a vesting schedule. Carries grant date, type, share count, strike (if option), vesting cadence, performance metrics, and forfeiture rules. Integrates with external equity-administration platforms.
Aggregated exception records: unique exception fingerprint, first/last seen, occurrence count, affected releases, environments, owners, status (unresolved/resolved/ignored).
Policy that escalates overdue training through manager, skip-level, HR Business Partner, or compliance officer.
Prepared report per framework (CSRD, CDP, GRI, SASB, TCFD, SEC Climate Rule, ISSB) for a fiscal year; narrative + metrics + assurance status.
Action program to reduce emissions or improve social/governance KPI: renewable project, waste reduction, DEI hiring program. Tracks budget, actuals, impact.
Derived KPI roll-up: total Scope 1/2/3 emissions, intensity ratios (per $M revenue, per FTE), water/waste/DEI/governance metrics. Reporting-cycle refresh.
Commitment goal (SBTi, Net Zero, reduction %): target year, baseline year, scope coverage, approval status. Tracked vs actuals.

A reusable quality scorecard definition: sections, weighted items, scoring scale, auto-fail criteria, and the queues or skills it applies to. Versioned so historical scores remain interpretable against the form in force when scored.

Clustered group of events and alerts identified as a single underlying incident — the noise-reduction artifact. A storm of 200 alerts collapses to one correlation with a candidate root-cause CI and the suggested incident.

Raw timestamped sequence of business-process events (state transitions, activities, timestamps, actors, resource allocations) extracted from system logs, business documents, or event streams. Primary input artifact for process discovery and conformance checking.
A heightened-monitoring assessment of a departing employee during the resignation, transfer, or termination window, scoring exit-related data-theft risk and driving watchlist placement.
Hypothetical or committed exit-proceeds scenario: total deal value, structure, deal terms. Drives the exit_waterfall_calculation.
Per-shareholder proceeds calculation under an exit_scenario, respecting liquidation preferences, participation rights, conversion economics.
Individual line on an expense_report: date, merchant, category, amount, tax, billable flag, receipt reference. The atomic expense unit feeding GL coding.
Configurable rule: per-diem caps, category limits, mandatory receipts, mileage rates, FX rounding. Applied at expense_line entry to flag violations.
Employee-submitted bundle of expense_lines for a trip, project, or period. Carries submission status, approval chain, reimbursement / payroll-payback routing.
Court filing on behalf of a law-firm client (venue, judge, docket, key dates) — distinct from LSD in-house dockets.
Federated external-user/cross-workspace access invitation: inviting_user, invited_email_or_tenant, status (pending / accepted / revoked), expiry, scope.

Single structured value extracted from a document by an IDP model. Carries document_id, field_name, field_value, extraction_confidence, model_version, extraction_timestamp. The granularity unit for field-level validation.
Logical grouping of extracted fields as a single business entity (invoice with line_items, form with section_answers). Carries record_type, aggregate_confidence, extraction_timestamp, status.
Emissions inventory at facility/plant/building granularity: metered utility data → activity_data → emissions by scope/source.
