Periodic recurrence configuration that drives FINRA / BSA-AML / HIPAA / OSHA refresh assignment cycles.
Legal hold + disposition rules per document class (regulatory retention periods, destruction dates).
Free-text recruiter note attached to a candidate, application, or pool, time-stamped and authored by a user.
Persisted recruiter boolean query over the candidate database. Carries filter expression, last_run timestamp, alert preferences.
Junction between candidates and recruitment_events recording registration, check-in, attendance, and conversion outcome.
Third-party recruiter or staffing firm supplying candidates. Tracks contract terms, contact, performance, and the candidates they have submitted.
Career fair, on-campus event, hackathon, or meetup used as a sourcing channel. Tracks attendees, captured leads, and event ROI.
Channel a candidate came from: job board, referral, agency, sourcing campaign, career event, or inbound. Used for source-of-hire analytics and channel ROI.
A scheduled charge generated from a contract: dockage, storage, or service fees billed on a periodic cadence.
Reward catalog entry — point values, redemption eligibility rules, partner-offer linkage.
Fulfillment of a loyalty reward redemption (point deduction, reward shipment, partner settlement).
Time-bounded promotion offering bonus referral rewards (e.g. 'double bonus for engineering Q3 2026', 'spot-bonus for hard-to-fill roles'). Scopes a referral_rewards override.
Individual payout instance triggered when a referred candidate is hired and meets tenure conditions. Lifecycle: pending -> approved -> paid (-> clawed_back).
Bounty rule defining the payout amount and conditions for a successful referral (e.g. $5000 paid 90 days after hire start, scaled by role level).

Reference catalog of substances controlled by product-substance regulations (RoHS Restricted Substances list, REACH SVHC list, REACH Annex XVII, conflict minerals 3TG, PFAS lists by jurisdiction). Each substance row carries CAS number, regulation pointers, threshold concentrations, and exemption references.
Export artifact for regulator submissions: OSHA 300, FINRA CE filings, state-CE rollups.
Government-side fee assessment for permits, licenses, inspections, citations: fee type, amount, due date, payer, payment status, allocation to fund. Distinct from S2P / billing.

Notification from regulator (SEC, FTC, GDPR authority, state AG): jurisdiction, inquiry type, subject, deadline, assigned counsel, response status. Distinct from PS-LIC inspections (regulator-as-issuer vs regulator-as-investigator).
Graph edges between people, organizations, and the firm: founder ↔ partner introductions, co-investor relationships, board observer assignments, advisor links.
Action plan to close an issue or failed control test; responsible party, target date, steps, evidence requirements, status.
Configured nudge cadence driving automated learner and manager reminders.

Established remote-control session: technician identity, target endpoint, session type (attended/unattended), start/end timestamps, transferred files, elevation events, and link to recording artifact. The unit of work in remote-access tools.
Tenant payment of rent (or other lease charges) via ACH, card, or cash; carries amount, allocation across charges, late fees, and reconciliation status.
Prospective-tenant application with personal/financial details, employer info, references, and screening results; precedes lease execution.

Residential lease agreement between landlord and tenant covering a specific rental unit; carries term, rent schedule, security deposit, addenda. Distinct from REAL-EST tenant-of-corporate-office leases (ASC 842 angle) and from commercial leases (different document structure, shorter term).
Lettable unit within a residential property (apartment, single-family rental, condo); carries amenities, sq-ft, current rent, lease status.
M:N links between product requirements (sourced from PROD-MGMT or internal specs) and test_cases that verify them. Supports coverage metrics and impact analysis.
Approval step in the chain that gates opening a job_requisition (hiring manager -> finance -> exec). Each step carries approver, decision, timestamp, rationale.
Assignment of person / team / asset to an initiative or roadmap item for a time period; utilization % and cost rate. Capacity-checks against SWP.
Pool of skills / competencies across the resource base with proficiency levels — anchors PSA utilization forecasting.

Shift assignments, associate availability, store labor roster. RET-STORE-mastered scheduling execution; WFM masters canonical `work_schedules` for workforce-planning. Retail-specific scheduling logic (coverage bands, register staffing) lives here.
RMA header created by OMS in response to a customer-initiated return or shipment.returned event. Refund_status (pending / authorized / refunded), return_location, tracking.
Period revenue forecast snapshot by segment and roll-up, recording the committed, best-case, and pipeline category calls for a given forecast period.
ASC 606 / IFRS 15 deferred-revenue schedules: performance obligations, allocation across obligations, recognition timeline, recognized vs deferred amounts. The bridge between SUB-MGMT and Finance/GL.

Pre-hire right-to-work verification event (the I-9 employment eligibility check or E-Verify confirmation itself), distinct from the supporting documents the candidate provides. Tracks the verification method, status, verifier, completion date, and any tentative or final non-confirmation, and handles data subject to federal employment-eligibility law.
Periodic or event-driven exercise to identify, analyze, and evaluate risks; type (enterprise / process / threat), scope, date, register version, findings.

A configured behavioral indicator or detection rule (for example, large download before resignation, upload to personal cloud, access to data outside role) that contributes weight to user risk scores and fires alerts.

The installed RMM agent on an endpoint or server: its version, last check-in time, health, configuration state, and telemetry-channel status. Distinct from configuration_items (CMDB's relationship/abstraction model) and hardware_assets (HAM's financial/lifecycle model) — rmm_agents is the operational liveness view used by RMM tools.
Planned product/capability delivery slated for a future release cycle; carries dependencies and contingency planning. Drives PROD-MGMT consumption.
Meeting room, event space, or collaborative area reservation by employee or team: time slot, capacity, amenities requested.

RCA record — ML-suggested or human-confirmed. Links candidate root-cause CIs to the correlated event cluster and the resulting incident. Seeds ITSM problem records via the root_cause.identified handoff.
The right-of-use asset recognized for a lease: initial measurement, accumulated amortization, impairment, and carrying value over the lease term under ASC 842 or IFRS 16.
Discrete UI-level action within an rpa_bot (click, type, extract_text, wait, conditional_branch). Sequenced to form the bot logic.
Per-execution trace of individual activity: activity_id, sequence, status, screenshot (optional), data_captured, timestamp, error_details.
Stored secrets used by bots: credential_type (username/password / API key / OAuth token), target_system, encrypted_value, rotation_policy.

Automated agent definition: name, description, process flow/logic, trigger conditions, error handling rules, version history. The RPA master entity. Distinct from IPAAS `integration_recipes` (server-to-server orchestration); RPA bots drive UI-level interactions across legacy applications.
Versioned, distributable bot package: version, release_notes, package_checksum, deployment_timestamp, target_environment (dev / staging / prod), deployed_by.
Single run of an rpa_bot: start_time, end_time, status (success / failure / paused), execution_log, input_variables, output_results.
Recurring bot execution configuration: frequency (cron), timezone, enabled/disabled state, next_run_timestamp, retention_policy for execution logs.
Tenant, workspace, domain, or instance of a SaaS platform. Data residing in SaaS platforms (security-posture lens).
Synthetic or real-user monitoring of SaaS app availability and response time from multiple geographies, networks, ISPs. Captures internet/WAN path quality as seen by end users.

Canonical SaaS app in the portfolio (collaboration, CRM, productivity, design, work-management tools). Carries vendor, category, criticality tier, sanctioned/shadow flag, and links to the active subscription. Distinct from SAM's software_titles which are typically installed (or hybrid). The flagship SMP entity.

The contractual instance for a SaaS app: plan / tier, seat count, MRR or ARR, billing cadence, renewal date, primary owner. One app may have multiple subscriptions (BU, region, M&A-inherited free tier). Linked to a contract (CLM) and a PO (S2P).
Per-app per-user activity metrics: logins, time-in-app, feature usage, last-active date. The basis for license right-sizing, renewal-tier decisions, and shadow-IT vs sanctioned-app analysis.
A workplace injury, illness, near-miss, or unsafe condition, with investigation, root-cause analysis, and recordability determination.
Pay-range structure by grade and geographic zone with minimum, midpoint, maximum, and benchmarking source. Drives offer guidance, merit eligibility, and pay-equity gap analysis.

Logged touchpoint between sales and a contact/opportunity — call, email, meeting, demo, content view. SALES-ENG sub-domain may co-master if its data_objects load expands later (cadence sequences, call recordings).

Multi-step outreach sequence: touchpoint definitions (call, email, social, video, voicemail-drop), timing, branching rules based on engagement. The core entity of sales-engagement platforms; enrollment can be manual (rep choice) or automated (CDP intent signal, CRM opportunity stage).
Individual sales emails sent (1-1, not blasts) — open/reply/click tracking, thread context, sentiment. Distinct from MA `marketing_emails` (volume-scale, list-driven, brand-template-bound).
A managed sales-facing content asset (deck, one-pager, demo script) with draft, publish, and retire states.
Versioned, numbered quote document with quote date, validity, currency, terms, status (draft → presented → accepted → lost), total-price rollup. N:1 to CRM `opportunities`.
Recovery of salvageable property or proceeds from damaged/totaled assets following settlement: salvage vendor, recovery_amount, disposal record, applied against claim total. P&C-specific.
Cleaning / sanitation completion record per shift / line / equipment with verification (ATP swab, visual).
What-if strategic scenarios (M&A, market disruption, expansion). Branches EPM `financial_scenarios` and SWP `workforce_scenarios`.
Canonical schemas for data flowing through pipelines: field contracts, versioning, evolution rules. Feeds lineage.
SCORM / AICC / cmi5 content package import; carries content interop manifest and runtime state.
A safety data sheet for a hazardous substance, carrying hazard classification, exposure limits, and handling guidance for hazard communication under HazCom and REACH or CLP.
Shareholder-initiated sale of existing equity: tender offer, employee liquidity program, or direct transfer. Board-approval workflow.
Class of security in the cap table: common, preferred series (Seed/A/B/...), SAFEs, warrants. Carries liquidation preference, participation rights, conversion ratio.
DXP-local audience cluster for personalization (distinct from CDP `audience_segments` which are behavioral cross-channel).

Metric or dimension definition in the platform's semantic layer: metric views, semantic models, ontology measures, governed metrics. The reusable, governed measure consumed by BI tools and AI agents alike.
Detected over-privilege, toxic combination (PII + public access), unauthorised access, shadow-data exposure. DSPM remediation trigger.
Definition of what can be requested: the form schema, fulfillment workflow, approval routing, SLA, and the price/charge-back rules. Each service request instance references a catalog item.

Planned modification to a service or configuration item. Carries change type (standard, normal, emergency), risk score, CAB approval state, implementation window, and back-out plan. The boundary object between ITSM and CMDB — CIs are updated as a result of an executed change.
Meter-to-grid/pipe hookup asset: pole/pedestal/pit location, conductor/pipe size, install date, maintenance history. Parent to outage-impact assessment and work-order routing.
SLA-bearing service contract (response time, parts coverage, call-out fees) — distinct from CLM canonical contracts.
A quoted estimate for boatyard work: scope, labor hours, parts, and price, approved by the boater before work begins.

Unplanned interruption of, or quality reduction to, a service. Carries severity, priority, category, assignee, affected CI(s), and the MTTR clock. The flagship ITSM work item. ITOM and SECOPS feed in (events become incidents, security alerts become incidents).

Service-level objective definitions and breach state: target (e.g. 99.9% requests under 300ms over 28 days), error budget remaining, burn rate, last breach. Drives the slo.breached handoff that creates incidents.
Business-service-to-CI mapping: which CIs underlie a named business service. The bridge between technical topology (CMDB / DISCOVERY) and business impact (used by ITSM, SECOPS, OBS).
Service mesh installations: traffic policy, mTLS enforcement, distributed tracing config.

The back-end service definition (commitments, supported configurations, and fulfillment details) split from its user-facing catalog item presentation. One offering can back several catalog items, and a catalog item can present one offering.

A customer-facing outage or status record, separate from the internal incident. Captures the affected service, the public status (investigating, identified, monitoring, resolved), start and end times, and the customer-facing message. Distinct from the internal incident work item.

Recurring preventive-maintenance plan attached to an installed_equipment unit. Defines cadence, due date, grace window, and overdue escalation. Drives proactive work-order generation when the next service is due.

Root-cause record for one or more incidents that recur or share a pattern. Carries known-error workaround, permanent fix candidate, and links to the change that will resolve it. Problem management is a discipline mature ITSM tools support but most orgs underuse.
Client-facing engagement: scope, contract, start/end, billing type (T&M / fixed_fee / milestone / retainer), revenue recognition method, project manager, billing entity.

Orchestration state + task list for activation / change / closure: workflow steps, dependencies, automation/manual flags, current state, errors. Operational view of how a telco_service_order is executed.

A release or deployment record that bundles one or more changes into a single shippable unit. Carries the release window, the included changes, deployment status, and rollback plan. Distinct from a single change ticket.

Planned, catalog-driven request: access, hardware, software, information. Distinct from incidents — incidents are reactive, service requests are proactive. The fulfillment for many requests crosses domains (provisioning ↔ IGA, asset assignment ↔ ITAM, HR exception ↔ HRSD).

Service-level agreement record: response-time, resolution-time, and availability targets per priority / category / customer tier. SLAs attach to incidents, service requests, and changes; breach metrics roll up to operational KPIs.

Subscriber-reported service-degradation/outage ticket: subscriber, service, severity, opened/resolved timestamps, root cause, resolution. Distinct from ITSM `incidents` (internal IT) and FSM customer field-service tickets.
Customer-facing service job request fulfilled by field visits — distinct from VMS preventive-maintenance work orders.
Per-session attendance roster row per learner. OSHA-mandated evidence for required workplace training.
Cancellation or no-show record for an ILT session, driving waitlist promotion.

Video and audit-log artifact captured from a remote session: storage location, retention policy, redaction state, and downstream compliance evidence. Distinct artifact lifecycle from the parent remote_sessions record.
Pre-session enrollment snapshot for an ILT session; attendance proof basis.
Detected data store, file, or SaaS instance not in official inventory; unmanaged or rogue replica.

SaaS app discovered in use but not officially sanctioned. Found via expense data (corporate card SaaS charges), SSO logs (unsanctioned login), browser extensions, network traffic, or signup-with-corporate-email detection. The thing finance, security, IT, and SMP all want to see but historically nobody owns end-to-end.
Per-shareholder holding record across all security classes for an issuer.

A worker-initiated request to swap or give up a shift, or to pick up an open shift, conducted as a conversation on the worker's device and routed for manager approval before handoff to the workforce-management schedule.

Operator-initiated issue/escalation: andon pull, quality defect escape, safety concern, equipment anomaly, material shortage. Work item for shop-floor problem-solving team. Distinct from FSM support tickets.

E-signature envelope: signing audit trail, IP addresses, external e-signature provider envelope and document reference IDs, and the signed PDF artifact. Distinct from contracts, one contract may have many signature events (counterpart, amendment, renewal).
Connection metadata to downstream targets: auth, batch/stream mode, upsert keys, schema enforcement rules.

Special Investigation Unit fraud-investigation case: claim reference, indicators triggered, investigator, status (open / closed-confirmed / closed-unconfirmed), referral to law enforcement. Distinct from generic banking/compliance investigations.
Discrete proficiency-rating event against a skill, with rater, method (self, manager, peer, test), score, and timestamp.
Peer or manager validation of a claimed or inferred skill on a profile; one-shot social signal distinct from a formal assessment.
Audit record of a passive skill-inference batch on skill profiles: model version, input signals (learning, performance, work activity), outputs, timestamp.

Per-worker collection of skills with self-assessed and validated proficiency levels, derived from completed courses, certifications, performance signals, and inferred peer-comparison. The central artifact of HCM-side skills-cloud and talent-intelligence offerings.
A learning-path step bound to a skill plus a target proficiency threshold.
Versioned ontology of skill nodes, synonyms, parent-child relationships.
Individual skill node belonging to a taxonomy version; the row referenced by every profile entry, competency-model entry, and inference run.

Comparison of current-state skills inventory vs future-state demand by role, level, and geography. Drives build/buy/borrow strategy: which gaps to close via training (LMS), external hires (ATS), or contingent workforce. Outputs feed both SWP scenarios and LMS curriculum decisions.
The placement of a specific vessel in a specific slip, mooring, or rack for a period, linking inventory to a reservation or contract.
A seasonal or annual agreement licensing a slip, mooring, or rack to a boater: term, rate, included utilities, and renewal terms.
A request to dock or store a vessel for a transient or seasonal period: dates, vessel, requested space, rate, and check-in/out status.
A configured size class for slips and racks (length and beam bands) used for fit rules and rate lookup.
A boater's place in line for a slip type or period that is currently full, with offer and expiry tracking.

System-raised anomaly on the SaaS portfolio: shadow-IT signup detected, license-overage projected, renewal window opening, integration token expiring, vendor-risk score change. Distinct from monitoring_alerts (OBS/AIOPS infrastructure-grain). BetterCloud Alert Center and Torii Alerts are the flagship surfaces.

Per-app utilization and cost-per-seat benchmark vs an industry peer-set. Snapshot record per measurement period; carries headcount cohort, peer-percentile, and outlier flag. Productiv Benchmarks + Zylo Industry Benchmarks are the flagship.

Curated, published listing of a sanctioned SaaS application that employees can browse and request access to. Carries description, owner, request route, SSO availability, approval workflow. Distinct from saas_applications (the discovered inventory of what's running); the catalog is the publication of what's offered. LeanIX, Torii, BetterCloud flagship.

Discovered or configured connection between SMP and a SaaS application's APIs (SSO source, SCIM source, finance source, usage source). Per-app per-tenant, with auth state and last-sync time. Distinct from IPAAS integration_connectors (platform-grain vendor-connector definitions); BetterCloud's App Integrations flagship surface.

Portfolio-rationalization stage of a SaaS application (Evaluate, Pilot, Sanctioned, Sunset, Retired). Distinct from saas_applications.record_status (discovered, sanctioned, deprecated, deprovisioned), which tracks discovery state. The stage set follows the industry-standard TIME portfolio taxonomy (Tolerate, Invest, Migrate, Eliminate).

Typed role assignment of a user to a SaaS application (business owner, IT owner, finance owner, security owner). Not a flat FK on saas_applications because one app may have multiple typed owners; modeled by Productiv and LeanIX as a first-class junction.

Employee request for access to a SaaS application via the published catalog. Routes through manager + IT approval, then hands off to IGA for entitlement provisioning. App-grain (pre-IGA-handoff); distinct from iga_access_requests (entitlement-grain) and itsm_service_requests (generic catalog). Torii App Catalog requests + BetterCloud Self-Service Requests are the flagship.

Declarative orchestration: trigger + steps (provision in SaaS app, send notification, file offboarding action, request approval, escalate). BetterCloud Workflows + Torii Workflows are the flagship product surface. Distinct from iga_access_requests (request-side) and integration_recipes (generic iPaaS).

SMP's view of a user-to-app license seat: who holds a seat at which tier, cost-per-seat, utilization signal, last active. Drives reclamation and rightsizing. Correlates with an iga_user_entitlement record (the governance view of the same access fact); the two routinely diverge.

System-generated rightsizing or consolidation proposal against a SaaS subscription or application. Carries savings_estimate, rationale, recommendation type (downgrade tier, reduce seats, consolidate apps), status. Productiv Recommendations + Zylo Savings Opportunities are the flagship.

Executed reclamation against an smp_license_seat_assignment (revoke, downgrade, reassign) with savings_realized linkage. Tracks the operational payoff of the optimization workflow. BetterCloud License Recovery + Torii Reclaim workflows are the flagship.

Lifecycle envelope per renewal cycle: timeline, owner, vendor proposals received, BATNA notes, decisions taken. Buyer-side analog of CRM opportunities; distinct in that the buyer drives the negotiation. Productiv Renewal Pipeline + Zylo Renewal Workbench are the flagship.
Workstream task within a SaaS renewal cycle (renewal window notice, owner assignment, decision: renew/renegotiate/consolidate/cancel). Productiv, Zylo, Flexera Renewal workspace surfaces.

Chargeback split of a SaaS subscription across cost centers, business units, or projects, with allocation method (per-seat, per-headcount, fixed-percentage) and effective window. Zylo Cost Center Allocation + Flexera Chargeback Allocations are the flagship. Distinct from FINOPS cost_allocations (cloud-only).

Quote, counter-quote, and discount-applied artifact tied to a renewal engagement. Decision-provenance record for how the final commercial terms were reached; contributor into CLM at execution time. Productiv Negotiation Intelligence + Zylo negotiation insights are the flagship.

SaaS-specific vendor-risk scorecard: SOC 2 attestation status, ISO 27001, DPA review, subprocessor disclosures, breach history, posture score. Per-SaaS-application (Slack vs Salesforce risk profiles differ from the same vendor). Flexera Vendor Risk Scorecard is the flagship; pure-plays defer most risk surfaces to GRC.
Execution log per automation workflow invocation. Carries trigger source, input payload, step-by-step status, output, duration, and error if failed.

Brand-owned connected account on a specific social network with credentials, permissions, and channel-specific metadata. Covers major short-form, long-form, video, image-sharing, professional, and discussion-forum networks.
A connected advertiser account on a social ad platform (Meta Business, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, etc.) under which campaigns are run and billed.
A paid social campaign defining an advertising objective, schedule, and overall budget, parenting one or more ad sets across one or more ad platforms.
A versioned ad creative: the assembled visual-plus-copy unit (single image, video, carousel, collection) with approval state and platform-specific renditions, used by ads across campaigns.
Time-series delivery and outcome metrics per ad, ad set, or campaign (impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, ROAS, CPA, frequency) pulled from ad-platform insights APIs.
A targeting and budget unit within a campaign (Meta ad set, TikTok ad group, LinkedIn campaign tier) binding an audience, placements, bid strategy, schedule, and budget to a set of ads.
An individual deliverable ad within an ad set, pairing a creative with destination and tracking parameters and carrying its own delivery and review state on the ad platform.
Saved monitoring query/topic (keywords, hashtags, competitors, geographies, sentiment filters) that drives the listening pipeline. Configuration data with a long lifecycle.

Brand or keyword mention detected by social listening across networks, news, blogs, forums, and review sites — typically off-channel and from non-followers. Distinct from social_messages (on-channel inbox).

Inbound conversation in the unified inbox: comment, direct message, mention-reply, or review on a brand-owned account. The unit of engagement. Distinct from social_mentions (off-channel listening artifacts).
Authored social-channel post (draft, scheduled, or published) with per-channel variants, media assets, copy, lifecycle state, and approval history. The unit of work in publishing tools.

Release event of a build_artifact to a target environment (dev / staging / prod): deployer, started/finished timestamps, status, rollback flag, target environment, change-ticket reference. Scope-qualified vs `device_deployment_results` (UEM).

Discovered install of a software title on a specific device or for a specific user. The operational fact, distinct from the licensing right. Discovery feeds; VULN-MGMT reads to scope vulnerability scans.

License entitlement: vendor, title, purchased count, license model (per-user, per-device, concurrent, site, subscription), term, renewal date, governing contract. The legal right-to-use, distinct from actual installations.

Canonical software product in the catalog (e.g. a creative suite, productivity suite, CAD application, IDE). Carries vendor, edition, family, version range. Distinct from installations (which reference a title) and from licenses (which entitle a count of users to a title).
Connection metadata to upstream systems: auth mechanism, sync schedule, incremental-capture state, connector plugin type.
Raw record from a source system before match/merge processing; preserves provenance and source identifier for lineage.

Git repository hosted on the VSDP platform: name, default branch, visibility (public / internal / private), language, owner, last-activity. Distinct from KMS knowledge artifacts and DAM digital_assets.
OMS routing logic output: which warehouse will fulfill which line, with rationale (lowest_cost / fastest_ship / fulfills_split / 3pl_preference / exception_override) and confidence_score.

RFx process record: RFI, RFQ, RFP, or reverse auction. Carries scope, supplier list, scorecard / weighting, responses, and the awarded supplier. The pre-contract stage that produces a sourcing decision feeding CLM.
Analytics on actual office occupancy/usage: peak-hour patterns, underutilization zones, utilization rates. Drives real-estate optimization. Distinct from REAL-EST `occupancy_records` (operational).
Stockroom counts and procurement of replacement hardware components (not yet deployed assets).
Pre-spend authorization rules (card limits, vendor restrictions, approval matrices) — distinct from EXPENSE post-hoc policies.

Pre-spend approval request raised by an employee before a purchase, for a virtual card, raised card limit, vendor bill, or reimbursement budget. Modern spend-management platforms anchor on this proactive request workflow as the entry point before any transaction occurs. Lifecycle: draft -> submitted -> approved/declined -> spent (linked to one or more card_transactions / payment_runs).
Investor commitment to an SPV: simpler than fund-level lp_subscriptions; typically smaller LP base, single capital call at close.
Special Purpose Vehicle — single-deal investment vehicle (LLC-typed) with limited LP base. Dominant vehicle below ~$25M deal size.
Visual representation of building floors and suites showing current occupants, lease-expiration dates, vacant suites, and combinability options; the working tool of CRE leasing.
Agency or managed-service provider relationship with tiered preference, performance scorecard, master service agreement, and certified-recruiter roster.
Autoclave/steam-sterilization records for reusable surgical instruments: cycle parameters (time, temp, pressure), batch ID, QA certification. Validates sterile-field integrity pre-procedure.
A land or trailer storage space for a vessel kept ashore: location, size, and assigned vessel.
Daily/shift store operational checklist (open / close / safety / cleanliness / loss-prevention). Template-driven execution and sign-off records.
In-store compliance/operational audit (health/safety, merchandising, inventory accuracy, point-of-sale). Distinct from enterprise AUDIT (`audit_plans` / `audit_findings`).
B2C-COMM order subcase where fulfillment = store pickup. OMS masters store-assignment and hold-time orchestration: allocated_store_id, hold_window_start/end, pickup_status.

Task assigned to retail associates (shelf stocking, planogram execution, zone cleaning, till reconciliation, safety checks). Core unit of store-level workforce execution and accountability. Scope-qualified vs onboarding_tasks, project_tasks.
The mapping between a listing and an external booking channel or OTA, with sync status for rates and availability.
A message in the unified guest inbox tied to a reservation, inbound or outbound across any channel.
A guest profile: contact details, identity/verification status, and stay history across reservations.
A cleaning or turnover task scheduled against a listing, typically fired by a checkout, assigned to a cleaner or team.
A rental unit as marketed and published to booking channels: address, amenities, capacity, house rules, photos, and availability.
A record of occupancy/lodging tax collected on a reservation and its filing and remittance to the taxing jurisdiction.
A periodic trust-accounting statement for a property owner: booking revenue, commissions, pass-through expenses, and the net payout.
A local short-term-rental registration or permit for a listing: permit number, jurisdiction, issue and expiry dates, and status.
An owner whose properties a manager operates: contact details, management agreement, commission terms, and payout details.
Pricing configuration for a listing: base and seasonal rates, dynamic-pricing rules, fees, and min/max-stay constraints.
A guest stay booked against a listing: dates, channel of origin, party size, pricing, and payment and check-in/out status.
A review left after a stay, by a guest about a listing or by a host about a guest, synced across channels.
Multi-quarter / annual program aligned to corporate strategy; bundles related projects, has executive sponsor and benefits realization plan.
Container for strategic initiatives grouped by business unit, product line, or cost center; aggregate KPIs and investment rules.

Decisions captured during operating reviews or strategy off-sites: changes to objective priorities, resource reallocation, initiative go/no-go, scope adjustments. Single decision-maker per record; once decided, the record is locked except by explicit revert.

Balanced-scorecard and strategy-house visualizations linking strategic pillars to objectives, initiatives, and measures across financial, customer, process, and learning perspectives. Configured once per planning horizon; rarely changes structure.
GDPR Article 15 subject-access-request ticket: requester, scope, fulfillment status, regulator deadline.
Sublease grant / consent / commencement / termination with its own financial lifecycle vs the head lease.
Insurer pursuit of recovery from a liable third party: claim reference, third party, coverage class, demand amount, status, recovery amount, date range. Reduces net loss after a claim is paid.
Executed legal subscription package for an LP subscription: the signed agreement, side documents, and version history that persists across amended subscriptions.
Bench plan for a critical position: identified successors, readiness ratings (ready_now, 1-2_years, 3+_years), development plans, risk-of-loss assessment.
Supplier-issued certification document (GFSI, organic, kosher, halal, allergen statement, insurance COI) with expiry tracking.
Vendor ESG performance profile: questionnaire responses, audit results, certifications (ISO 14001, B-Corp), Scope 3 estimate. Annual refresh.
Single resolved supplier identity across all source systems (S2P/SUP-LIFE), resolved via match/merge/survivorship.

Supplier-issued invoice for goods or services delivered. AP runs 3-way match (PO + receipt + invoice) before approving for payment. Multi-domain consumption: EXPENSE consumes when a corporate card path overlaps, FINOPS consumes the cloud-invoice slice for cost allocation.
Onboarding workflow instance for a new supplier: invitation, registration form, document collection (W-9, banking, insurance, compliance attestations), approval chain.
Risk and compliance profile for an active supplier: sanctions screening, financial-health rating, ESG scoring, ISO/SOC certifications, cyber-risk assessment. Periodically reassessed.
Operational / financial / cyber risk-scoring record per supplier; feeds GRC consumption.
KPI-weighted performance rating of a supplier over a period: on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, savings delivered. Drives tier preference in sourcing decisions.
Vendor master record: legal name, tax id, addresses, payment terms, contacts, currency, statuses, risk profile. The supplier-side analog to the customer master.

A contact-center interaction record (voice call, chat session, video session, callback). Captures session metadata: duration, channel, agent, customer, resolution status. Distinct from CSM's customer_cases (the support case is the business artifact; the support_session is the engagement event that may or may not result in a case).
Listening cadence definition: annual engagement, pulse, lifecycle (onboarding, 30/60/90-day, exit), 360-feedback. Carries audience, question set, frequency, anonymity floor.
Individual employee response to a survey_campaign instance. Aggregated under anonymity thresholds to engagement_drivers; never exposed at individual level to managers below floor.

Proactive end-to-end test against a SaaS app from a geo/network location: request/response payload, HTTP status, latency, SSL validity, geo tag, schedule reference. Network-outside-in probes (vs OBS instrumented internals).
Group session where managers normalize ratings across populations to remove rater bias and fit forced-distribution constraints. Produces calibrated performance_reviews outcomes.
Junction between candidates and talent_pools. Carries added timestamp, source, status_in_pool (cold/warm/hot), match score, and last_engagement timestamp.
Curated segment or pipeline of candidates kept warm for future roles (e.g. silver medallists, alumni, target-school grads, hard-to-fill skill clusters).

Rule-based pool definition (boolean filter over candidates) that materializes membership automatically. Examples: 'Senior PMs in NYC with FinTech experience', 'Engineering alumni who left in the last 2 years'.
A named, approved list of accounts to pursue in the plan period; the handoff artifact to CRM and the ABM platform.

Federal, state, provincial, or local taxing jurisdiction with rate tables, deposit schedules, and reporting forms. Includes US IRS/state/locals, UK HMRC, German Finanzamt, French URSSAF, Australian ATO.
Periodic statutory submission to a tax authority (US 941/W-2, UK FPS/EPS, German DEUEV/Lohnsteueranmeldung, French DSN, Australian STP). Includes payment and reporting; failure carries penalties.

Tax-return record managed by a preparer: tax year, return type (1040, 1120, 1065, etc.), client, status (in-prep, review, ready-for-signature, filed, accepted, rejected), filing method, refund/balance-due.
Crawl-based SEO issue: meta robots block, missing canonical, duplicate content, page-speed bottleneck, sitemap misconfiguration, structured-data error. Distinct from keyword/topical SEO (MA-owned).
Evaluation of an application's tech-stack alignment with enterprise standards and vendor roadmap; score + gap analysis + remediation roadmap.
Vendor platform / tech stack with version, EOL, upgrade status, org-wide instance count. Distinct from `vendors` (legal entity) and `solutions` (product).
Subscriber bill — multi-rated usage + subscription + tax lines, billing-period summary, payment status. Distinct from S2P invoices, SUB-MGMT `customer_invoices`, and rent_payments.
Commercial service offerings with technical specifications, rate plans, and SLA terms; TM Forum eTOM catalog master. Distinct from internal IT service catalogs and SaaS pricing catalogs.

Service provisioning order (activate / modify / suspend / deactivate). Carries customer, service catalog reference, requested date, status, fulfillment workflow reference. Distinct from B2C-COMM `orders` (commerce) and SUB-MGMT customer-subscription change orders.

Active service instance per subscriber (mobile line, fiber connection, leased circuit): carrier-customer relationship with the operational service. Distinct from SUB-MGMT `customer_subscriptions` (SaaS seller-side).
Commercial-tenant financial health, payment history, default risk; underwrites CRE leasing decisions.

Tenant-submitted issue tracked from intake through vendor dispatch to resolution; carries photos, urgency, communication thread. Distinct from FM/EAM work orders in that the requester is a paying tenant, not an internal employee.
A carved sales territory: the accounts and geography assigned to a rep or team.
Reusable test definition (manual or automated reference): preconditions, steps, expected results, tags, traceability to requirements and test suites.
Defect discovered during testing; distinct from ITSM incidents. Carries reproduction steps, environment context, severity, priority, assigned developer, status, root cause.
Configured environment (OS variant, browser, device, SaaS tenant version, DB state) where test execution occurs. Enables matrix testing and environment-specific failure traceability.
Master planning document scoping test coverage, timeline, resources, environment assignments, entry/exit criteria for a release or phase.
Single execution instance of a test_case or suite against a target environment: outcome (pass / fail / blocked / skipped), duration, environment context, tester, failure logs.
Grouping of test_cases by feature/release/type. Enables batch execution, cross-browser/environment matrix, organized reporting.
Recorded clock-in / clock-out / break event from a time-collection device, mobile app, or manual entry. Approved time entries are the WFM↔PAYROLL handoff payload.

Accrual / entitlement rule definition for a leave type: by country, role, tenure tier, with caps, carry-over, and conversion rules. Country-specific by statute (US PTO, UK statutory leave, German Urlaub, French Congés Payés).
A configured integration to an external delivery tool from which work items and events are mirrored into the value-stream model.
Scheduled property showings with lock-box codes, access windows, agent attendance, and follow-up tracking.
Lot / batch identifier per FSMA-204 Traceability Lot Code (TLC); links upstream sources to downstream consignees.
Labeled document samples used to train or fine-tune IDP extraction models. Carries document_type, sample_count, labeling completion, training window, lineage to trained models.
Inspection-ready evidence package: signed roster, certificate hash, content version, signature record reference. Generated for regulator submission.
Reservation of a physical or virtual room and resources for an instructor-led session.
In-flight data transformation logic: mappings, UDFs, validation rules, masking policies. May delegate to external compute or SQL engines.
Imported itinerary from a travel-booking partner: air, hotel, ground. Pre-trip approval and post-trip expense reconciliation.

The configured set of rules that govern what travelers may book: fare classes, advance-purchase windows, preferred suppliers, spend caps, and out-of-policy handling. Drives policy-aware shopping and approval routing.

The per-traveler record holding seat and meal preferences, loyalty and frequent-traveler memberships, travel documents (passport, visa, known-traveler numbers), and emergency contacts that personalize shopping and satisfy identity and duty-of-care requirements.

A pre-trip authorization request and its decision, routed when a trip is out of policy, over a cost threshold, or bound for a high-risk destination, capturing the approver, the decision, and any exception justification.

A single reservation at the reservation-record level: a flight, hotel stay, rail journey, or car rental with its confirmation, fare or rate, ancillaries, and ticketing status. The bookable unit a segment is created from.
The ordered set of travel segments (air, hotel, rail, car, ground) for a trip, assembled from individual reservations and kept synchronized as segments are added, changed, or disrupted.

A returned set of bookable options for a shopping request, aggregated from GDS, NDC, and direct-supplier content and ranked against travel policy. Derived from a search query against live inventory; the basis from which a booking is made.

IOLTA-style trust-account ledger: per-client and per-matter balances, three-way-reconciliation evidence, state-specific retention. Distinct from operating accounts; commingling is an ethics violation.
Residual value from an unused or partially used ticket that can be reapplied to a future booking, tracked through its available, reapplied, and expired states so prepaid value is recovered.
Metered-billing inputs — events / consumption units / overage credits feeding usage-based pricing tiers. Stream from product instrumentation (or B2C-COMM events) into SUB-MGMT for cycle aggregation.
Computed risk score for an individual insider, derived from weighted behavioral indicators over a scoring window. Updates continuously as new activity arrives.

Semantius platform-owned user table. Referenced from domain `data_objects` via `data_object_relationships` for assignee / author / approver / creator edges. Not surfaced in domain-level analytics (Signal 1/2 ignore `kind='platform_builtin'`).

Utility-owned network infrastructure (substations, transformers, poles, distribution lines, pipelines): type, location, capacity, age, operational status. Distinct from EAM `industrial_assets` (corporate plant) and HAM (IT).
Customer invoice: aggregates meter_reads, regulatory adjustments (demand charges, time-of-use rates, tariffs), payment terms. Distinct from telco_customer_bills, S2P invoices, and rent_payments.

Legal customer-premise record tied to a utility service territory: contract, billing profile, meter assignment, connection status. Residential, commercial, industrial scopes. Distinct from CRM `customers` (sales context).
Electricity, water, gas, waste consumption recorded per period. Source of ESG Scope 1+2 activity data (feeds ESG `activity_data_records`).

Physical meter device at a customer premise (electric/gas/water): device type, manufacturer, install date, certified accuracy class, commissioning state. Distinct from REAL-EST `utility_meter_readings` (the read) and from the meter as a corporate-buyer concept.

Work request to establish new connection / disconnect / move / modify service (not maintenance): premise, requested date, work type, fulfillment status. Distinct from EAM `eam_work_orders` and FSM customer work orders.
IRS 409A fair-market-value report for an issuer: methodology (income / market / asset / OPM backsolve), per-class FMV, valuation date. Final once approved; superseded by future 409As.
A structured value proposition mapping a capability to a persona outcome and competitive differentiation.

DORA-style or VSM-style measurement per repository or product: lead time for changes, deployment frequency, MTTR, change failure rate, computed over a window. Derived/computed; distinct from raw ci_pipeline_runs.
End-to-end value flow from customer demand to customer-realized value, with lead time, process time, value-add ratio, waste categorization, and SIPOC/customer-journey overlays.
Site-specific application prescription map (shapefile / ISO-XML) authored from yield zones and soil tests; dispatched to machinery.

Actual-vs-plan reconciliation records: account, period, planned amount, actual amount, variance, and root-cause commentary. The operational analytic output of EPM; consumed by org leaders, FP&A, and PA (when variance touches people cost).
Investment opportunity flowing through the deal pipeline (sourced → diligence → IC → term sheet → closed / declined). Domain-prefixed to avoid collision with M&A / IB deal records.
Driver Vehicle Inspection Report (DVIR) record: pre-trip or post-trip, defects identified, photos, driver signature. Defects route to maintenance work orders.
Parts stocked in garages / service bays for immediate vehicle repair use.
GPS-segmented trip record: start/end timestamps, route trace, distance, duration, idle time, jurisdictions (for IFTA), driver. Built from raw telemetry by the platform.

Maintenance or repair work order for a fleet vehicle: triggered by PM schedule, telematics fault, or inspection defect; task lines with labor and parts; assigned mechanic and shop; status lifecycle. Distinct from FSM customer-facing work orders.
Pre-payment approval workflow for vendor-direct payments — distinct from employee-initiated spend_requests.
A certificate of insurance on file for a vessel: insurer, policy number, liability limits, and expiry, required by most slip and storage contracts.
A state, Coast Guard, or documented-vessel registration record verified for a vessel: registration number, jurisdiction, and expiry.
A boat on file at the marina: name, type, length, beam, draft, hull identification, and owning boater.
Vesting cadence for an equity grant: cliff, vest_frequency, total months, single-trigger / double-trigger acceleration logic.
Structured lab result for an animal patient: tests, values, reference ranges, ordering vet, reporting lab (external reference lab or in-house analyzer).
Vaccination record for an animal patient: vaccine type, lot, administered date, expiry, next-due-date driving reminder workflow.

A chatbot or virtual-agent conversation transcript: the turn-by-turn exchange, the resolved intent, any deflection or escalation to a human agent, and the ticket it produced. Backs the Virtual Agent capability.
Linkage to an external video meeting (Zoom / Teams / Webex) for a virtual session; carries join URL and recording reference.
Timestamped record of all visitor state transitions (registration / check-in / badge / check-out / escalations): compliance audit trail.
Physical or digital badge credential issued upon check-in: encodes visitor identity, host assignment, access scope, expiration.
Arrival event: timestamped confirmation at facility entry, credential verification, badge-issuance trigger.
Real-time roster of visitors present on-site, correlated with spaces and emergency zones for emergency response and accountability.
Signed or electronically acknowledged non-disclosure agreement: legal-hold artifact per visit. Distinct from CLM `contracts` (corporate agreements).
Pre-visit registration: visitor arrival intent with expected access duration, host assignment, pre-screening completion. Initiates the visitor lifecycle.
Pre-arrival or arrival-time screening result against external watchlists (sanctions, banned-visitor, threat databases): compliance-hold record.

Voluntary candidate disclosure of protected-class membership (race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status, disability status) per EEOC and OFCCP self-id requirements. Distinct from `eeo_responses` which captures the survey response: this row captures the offer/decline-to-answer decision and audit metadata.

A specific weakness detected on a specific asset, deduplicated across scans and tracked through its own lifecycle from open to closed. The headline noun of the domain: a vulnerability links an asset (mastered in ITAM/CMDB) to a vulnerability definition and carries severity, computed risk, ownership, and current state.

A scoped, point-in-time assessment or remediation campaign over an asset population, grouping vulnerabilities for a posture snapshot, audit window, or program milestone. Carries scope, time window, and an aggregate posture summary.

The catalog of known vulnerabilities (CVE identifiers, vendor advisories, plugin or check metadata, affected products, base CVSS severity, references) that incoming scan findings are matched against and enriched from. A reference catalog, not an operational record.

A governed, time-boxed risk acceptance, deferral, or false-positive designation for vulnerabilities the business chooses not to remediate now. Carries justification, requesting and approving parties, scope, and an expiry that drives re-review. Single-approver sign-off gates activation.

Operational remediation work that resolves one or more vulnerabilities: the owning team, due date, SLA, patch or configuration guidance, and verification status. The security-side workflow record; where fixes are executed through a service desk it hands off to ITSM change or incident records.

A scan job run against an asset population using a scan policy or template, progressing through queued, running, and completed states and emitting the findings that become vulnerabilities. Scope-qualified to avoid collision with discovery_scans (ASM) and other scan entities.
Capacity overflow queue for a course offering; priority order and notify-on-seat-open policy.

A walk-up or onsite check-in record: the visitor, the reason for the visit, queue position, estimated service time, and outcome. Backs the Walk-Up capability. The kiosk is treated as a location attribute, not a separate entity.
Per-distribution waterfall computation: hurdle test, catchup, GP carry, LP returns. References the fund's distribution agreement (European / American / hybrid).

Per-page tracking record across web properties: URL/slug, status (published / draft / retired), last-modified, owner, publish date, review cadence, lifecycle stage. CMS-agnostic counterpart to HCMS `content_entries`.
A personalized web experience or landing page served to named accounts.
Storable, URL-routable page composition assembled from content_components for a DXP-served digital channel.
A rule mapping a resolved account/segment to a personalized web experience or variant.
A person/account-level de-anonymization of a web visitor; PII-bearing and consent-gated.
Event subscription: source_system, event_type, target_recipe, retry_policy, filter_logic.

Email, video, push notification, or SMS sent to a new hire during the journey — pre-boarding nudges, Day-1 schedule, post-Day-1 check-ins, cohort announcements. Carries channel, template, scheduled send time, delivery state, and engagement metrics.
B2B order from chef / restaurant / co-op / food-hub buyer; per-line pricing tier, packing-list reference, net-30 invoicing.
A structured interview with a won or lost buyer, capturing the decision drivers; carries interviewee identity and quotes.

Banking-side fund-transfer instruction: originating account, destination (domestic/international), amount, currency, requested delivery, beneficiary, purpose code, compliance flags (sanctions, threshold reporting), execution status, confirmation number. Distinct from S2P supplier payments.
Ordered or parallel set of work_approval_steps gating a work_item or work_project transition. Backs the APPROVAL-WORKFLOW capability (cross-cutting; this is the WORK-MGMT realization).
Single approval gate on a work_item or work_project, performed by a designated approver. Belongs to a work_approval_chain. Per-step states: pending / approved / rejected / expired.

Trigger-action rule defined per board/project: status change, due date, assignment, form submission as triggers; multi-step actions with conditions, time delays, and external integrations. The user-authored behavior layer on top of the data primitives.
Per-work_item value for a work_custom_field. Junction-style master: tuple (work_item, work_custom_field, value). Monday column_values, Asana custom_field_values, Smartsheet cells.

User-defined field attached to a work_project or workspace, typed (text, number, date, select, etc.). Applies to all work_items in scope. Monday columns / Asana custom fields / ClickUp custom fields / Workfront / Smartsheet column types.
Saved, shareable cross-project dashboard composed of configurable widgets that summarize work progress, workload, and goal status. Backs the cross-project dashboards capability.

Typed dependency between two work_items: predecessor/successor with type (FS finish-to-start, SS start-to-start, FF finish-to-finish, SF start-to-finish). Backs the WORK-DEPS-SCHED capability. Modeled by Asana, Monday, ClickUp, Workfront, Smartsheet.

Right-to-work evidence for a worker: visa, work permit, or equivalent authorization, effective-dated with an expiry the system tracks. Jurisdiction-conditional and access-restricted. Distinct from the US-specific hiring I-9 record.
Submitted instance of a work_form. Carries field values, submitter, timestamp. Converts to a work_item via routing rules. May contain personal content from form fields (requester name/email).
Structured intake form definition: schema (fields, validation), target project, routing rules. Asana Forms, Monday Forms, ClickUp Forms, Workfront Request Queues, Smartsheet Forms.
Contribution link between a work item or project and an okr_objective so that goal progress can roll up from the work that drives it.
Operator-facing step sequence for building/assembling a product variant: sequence, resource requirements, quality checkpoints, safety notes, attached media. References product + production_order.
File or external link attached to a work_item. May reference embedded content or platform-managed storage.
Threaded comment on a work_item. Asana stories / Monday updates / ClickUp comments / Workfront updates / Smartsheet conversations. May include personal or sensitive content.
Junction master between work_items and work_tags. Carries no qualifier of its own; existence asserts the tag is applied.

Atomic primitive in a work-management platform: task / item / card with owner, due date, status, priority, dependencies, subtasks, attachments, and comments. Same shape regardless of platform-specific terminology (task, item, row, card).
Zero-duration gate within a work_project marking a meaningful transition. Distinct from a regular work_item by gate semantics (passed/missed). Asana, Monday, ClickUp, Workfront, Smartsheet all model.
Fieldwork documentation: test procedures executed, evidence gathered, conclusions, sign-off. Keyed to audit_programs and control_tests.
Team-level grouping of related projects for cross-project status roll-up. Distinct from the top-down strategic portfolio mastered in the strategic-portfolio domain.
Reusable work_project blueprint with seeded sections, items, custom fields, and automations. Universal across all 5 flagships; central to enterprise rollout patterns.
Container of work_items, regardless of platform-specific terminology (project, board, sheet, space/list). Has timeline, status, owner, members, dashboards, and embedded views.
Published shift schedule for a department / location / week, derived from labor-demand forecasts and worker-availability constraints. The product of a scheduling-optimization run.
Container within a work_project that groups work_items for board/list views. Asana sections / Monday groups / ClickUp statuses-as-columns / Workfront statuses / Smartsheet parent rows.
A scheduled work block assigned to a worker: start, end, position, location, break plan, premium pay flags. The atomic scheduling unit.
Logged status-change event on a work item or project capturing the prior status, the new status, who changed it, and when.
Configurable status value in a project's or team's status taxonomy, with its category (not started, in progress, done) and display order.
Free-form label attached to work_items for cross-cutting categorization (priority, theme, status). Many-to-many to work_items via work_item_tags.
Reusable work_item blueprint with seeded assignee role, due-date offset, subtasks, and custom field defaults. Used for recurring or templated work creation.

Non-billable time logged against a work item for effort tracking and capacity reporting. Billable worklog with rate, utilization, and invoice stays mastered in the services-billing domain and is consumed, not re-mastered, here.
Per-user, per-period sum of allocated effort on work_items, with capacity ceiling. Backs the WORK-CAPACITY capability. Continuous-numeric, not state-driven. May expose individual workload.
Saved, named, shareable board / list / timeline / calendar view of work items with persisted filters, grouping, and sort. A configuration record, not a per-user UI toggle.
Home, work, and mailing addresses for a worker, effective-dated and typed by purpose, supporting multi-jurisdiction and country-variant formats.

Self-service request raised by an employee or manager to change worker data (personal details, address, job, or org assignment), routed through an approval workflow before it commits to the worker record. The self-service surface's first-class request object.

Fully-loaded cost forecast per period, by org unit / role / location / level. Inputs: headcount × comp band × loading factor (benefits, taxes, equity) × jurisdiction. The bridge to EPM — produced inside SWP from the workforce plan, then handed off to EPM where it's rolled into the consolidated budget. Without this object the SWP↔EPM boundary is fuzzy; with it, SWP masters the workforce-driven cost build and EPM masters the consolidated financial plan that consumes it.

Multi-year strategic plan covering target headcount, skills, location, and cost. The SWP umbrella entity; carries planning horizon (typically 1-5 years), base assumptions (attrition rate, hire ramp, productivity factor), approval state (draft / review / approved / published / reconciled), and pointers to the scenarios and forecasts that compose it.

What-if models layered on top of a base workforce plan. Each scenario carries a type (growth / reduction / restructure / geography_shift / skill_pivot / cost_optimization), the perturbation parameters, and the modeled outcome on headcount, skills, and cost. RIF planning, expansion planning, M&A integration, and reorgs all sit here.

Named cohort definitions used for analysis and intervention: hi-po, flight-risk, top-quartile-performer, early-career, returning-from-leave, regrettable-loss-risk. Drives Talent Mgmt programs (high_potential.identified is the canonical outbound handoff) and HR Service Delivery actions.
Employee survey/feedback on office experience: comfort, amenities, satisfaction. Informs workplace strategy and EX improvements.
Employee request for workspace changes: desk relocation, accommodation needs, floor reassignment. Routed to facilities for approval/execution. Workplace-scoped (vs generic ITSM service_requests).
Experience-API event log row capturing actor-verb-object learning activity inside or outside the LMS.
